samas.samasTitleEnglish: Bahudevasthan Nirupan (A Discourse on the Many Abodes of God)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: तुज नमूं गजवदना । तुझा महिमा कळेना । विद्या बुद्धि देसी जना । लाहानथोरांसी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गजवदना मी तुला नमस्कार करतो. तुझा महिमा कळत नाहीं. लहान आणि थोर माणसांना तूं विद्या व बुद्धि देतोस.
owis.englishMeaning: To you, Lord with the face of an elephant, I bow down (ie. I surrender my mind to you). Your greatness has not been understood, for the people give their understanding and their buddhi to a small jiva within that great brahman.

owis.original: तुज नमूं सरस्वती । च्यारी वाचा तुझेन स्फूर्ती । तुझें निजरुप जाणती । ऐसे थोड़े ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सरस्वती, मी तुला नमन करतो. चारहि वाणी तुझ्या सत्तेनें स्फुरतात. तुझें खरें स्वरुप ओळखणारे जगांत फार कमी असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: To you Goddess sarasvati, I bow down (ie. I surrender my mind to you). From your inspiration `I am' comes the four speeches. Few are they who know your form (ie. `all'/chaitanya).

owis.original: धन्य धन्य चतुरानना । तां केली सृष्टीरचना । वेद शास्त्रें भेद नाना । प्रगट केले ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मदेवा तूं धन्य आहेस. तूं सृष्टीरचना केलीस. वेद, शास्तरे व इतर अनेक भेद तूं प्रगट केलेस.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed are you lord brahma, the one with four *faces. Though you have created this gross world (ie. you are the decision making buddhi) and the `many' different concepts still, you also revealed the vedas and shasthras by which one can seek liberation. *(Four faces are four forms of birth; our buddhi puts us in a body and keeps us there until such time this conviction changes)

owis.original: धन्य विष्णु पाळण करिसी । येकांशें सकळ जीवांसी । वाढविसी वर्तविसी । जाणजाणों ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विष्णु, तूं धन्य आहेस, तूं पालन करतोस. आपल्या एका अंशानें सर्व जीवांना त्यांच्या अंतरंगाप्रमाणें वाढवतोस व वागवतोस.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed are you vishnu. You are this `all' and with this part of that One, you protect the jiva (vishnu is sattwa guna, with knowing we protect ourselves in this world). You are always knowing and due to this knowing, the jiva can exist and grow (if you give up these thoughts of being a jiva then, this knowing will always be there).

owis.original: धन्य धन्य भोळाशंकर । जयाच्या देण्यास नाहीं पार । रामनाम निरंतर । जपत आहे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भोळा शंकर धन्य होय. त्यच्या देण्याला कांहीं मर्यादाच नाहीं. तो निरंतर रामनाम जपत असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed are you, simple minded shankara (ie. tamo guna). There is no limit to this giving of yours (from nothing everything comes; you say, "I am a body" and you become a body; you say, "I am not a body" and you are not a body). You are always repeating the sacred name of ram. (vishnu and shankara are two sides of the same coin; when you forget everything, knowing is there)

owis.original: धन्य धन्य इंद्रदेव । सकळ देवांचाहि देव । इंद्रलोकींचें वैभव । काये म्हणौनि सांगावें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इंद्रदेव धन्य होय.तो सर्व देवांचा देव आहे. इंद्रलोकांचे वैभव वर्णन करणें कठिण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed are you lord indra. You are this `all' and the god of the gods also. When you rule, there are the glories of heaven, for you are the lord of the senses; but then how can there be that thoughtless nirgun? (When you understand this knowledge then, you are the lord of the senses. Then the senses no longer bring experiences one after another and there is this `experience' of everything all at one time ie. `now')

owis.original: धन्य धन्य येमधर्म । सकळ जाणती धर्माधर्म । प्राणीमात्रांचें वर्म । ठांई पाडिती ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यमधर्म धन्य होय. सगळ्यांना तो धर्म व अधर्म यांचे ज्ञान तो करुन देतो. जीवानें धर्म किती पाळला व अधर्म किती केला याचा बरोबर हिशोब तो करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed are you yama-dharma (ie. god of death). You are this `all', for you know d harma emphadharma (ie. dharma is to know you are not the body and adharma is to take yourself to be the body). But it is you who throws that thoughtless essence down into this place of the prana also (ie. he brings death at the allotted time and brings rebirth over and over again).

owis.original: वेंकटेसीं महिमा किती । भले उभ्या अन्न खाती । वडे धिरडी स्वाद घेती । आतळस आपालांचा ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: व्यंकटेशाचा महिमा फार आहे. तेथें चांगलीं माणसें उभ्यानें अन्न खातात. वडे, धिरडी व खमंग घारग्यांचा ते रसास्वाद घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In *venkatesha there is the greatness of nirgun and the `many' objects also. The wise always dine on this `food' of `I am' and they know that you venkatesha, are the One who knows the tastes and smells the aromas of the `many' cakes and breads (we say, "We taste and we smell"; but you venkatesha are the experiencer of all these). *(vishnu as the God dwelling in the cave in the mountain ie. in the secret place within the body)

owis.original: धन्य तूं वो बनशंकरी । उदंड शाखांचिया हारी । विवरविवरों भोजन करी । ऐसा कैंचा ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हे बनशंकरी तूं धन्य आहेस. तुझ्या नैवेद्याला खुप भाज्या असतात. त्यांतील प्रत्येक भाजीची चव घेऊन रसास्वाद घेणारा भक्त भेटणें कठीण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed are you who stays in bana-shankar (ie. mahesh; You understand this world is zero). But when your devotees offer to You fruits and vegetables then, they destroy that paramatma (Taking ourselves as devotees we come to a stone image of that God and offer `many' fruits and vegetables and neglect vivek; we forget You and take ourselves to be a body). But if one makes continuous investigation then, how can there be an enjoyer of these things? (The purush is called the enjoyer and doer and yet in that nirgun paramatma, the doer and enjoyer do not remain. That is real devotion and that is real vivek)

owis.original: धन्य भीम गोलांगुळा । कोरवड्यंच्य उदंड माळा । दहि वडे खातां ं । समाधान होये ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वानररुपी बलभीम हनुमान धन्य आहे. उडदाच्या पीठाचे वडे तळतात. व त्यांच्या माळा मारुतीरायास घालतात. दहिवडे खाऊन सर्वांचें समाधान होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed is powerful hanuman, the `monkey god' (ie. the lord of the prana and lord of the wandering mind). But that paramatma has become this never ending garland of fresh cakes and sweets that we consume (ie. we are hanuman, the lord of the prana and mind but taking ourselves to be a body with a belly, we never tire of just eating and then shitting). Only when these curds and cakes and even this `all' are consumed can there be samadhan (maharaj- if you make your belly empty you can understand the Reality).

owis.original: धन्य तूं गा खंडेराया । भंडारें होये पिंवळी काया । कांदेभरीत रोटगे खाया । सिद्ध होती ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खंडेराया तूं धन्य आहेस. तुझ्या दर्शनास आल्यावर भंडार्‍यानें सर्व अंग पिवळें होऊन जाते. मग कांद्याचे भरीत व रोडगे खायला सगळेजण आतुर होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed are you khanderaya (ie. another form of shiva). Your devotees rub yellow turmeric all over their bodies; they eat onion raita and special bread; while you require nothing (ie. your devotees forget that they are themselves shiva and take themselves to be a body).

owis.original: धन्य तुळजाभोवानी । भक्तां प्रसन्न होते जनीं । गुणवैभव गणी । ऐसा कैंचा ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तुळजाभवानी धन्य आहे. भक्तांवर ती प्रसन्न होते. तिचे अनंत गुण आहेत. त्यांची कल्पना कोणासच येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed are you goddess tulajabhovani (ie. another form of parvati, consort of shiva). Upon seeing your image (`I am everywhere'), your devotees feel happy in the mind. But in those mixed gunas (ie. objectification), how can there be that sattwa guna of grandeur and glory? (Don't be happy with being a body, be the consort of shiva ie. knowledge)

owis.original: धन्य धन्य पांडुरंग । अखंड कथेचा होतो धिंग । तानमाने रागरंग । नाना प्रकारीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पांडुरंग अतिशय धन्य आहे. त्याच्यासमोर कथाकिर्तनांचा गदारोळ अखंड चाललेला असतो. अनेक प्रकारचा तानमान आणि रागरंग तेथें अहर्निश चालतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed, most blessed is Pandurang. An unceasing tumult of kirtan and story-telling goes on before him. Many kinds of melody and musical mode play there day and night.
owis.note: John Norwell's English translation is truncated to a single stray letter ('v') for this owi, cut off right before a page break in the source PDF with no continuation afterward. The English above is a direct rendering of the sourced Marathi meaning rather than an independently cross-checked translation.

owis.original: धन्य तूं गा क्षत्रपाळा । उदंड जना लाविला चाळा । भावें भक्ति करितां फळा । वेळ नाहीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: क्षेत्रपाळ बहिरोबा, तूं धन्य आहेस. अनेक लोकांस तूं प्रेम लावलें आहेस. मनापासून तुझी भक्ति केली तर फळ मिळण्यास उशीर लागत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed are you kshetrapala (ie. the protector of the body ie. knowledge) for it is you who inspires the people to move. And when one's devotion to you is with understanding then, the fruit gained is beyond the `many' occasions and celebrations your devotee's make (ie. we have to go beyond the `many' thoughts and concepts and become this great celebration, `I am He').

owis.original: रामकृष्णादिक अवतार । त्यांचा महिमा अपार । उपासनेस बहुत नर । तत्पर जाले ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राम, कृष्ण वगैरे हे अवतार आहेत. त्यांचा महिमा फारच मोठा आहे. पुष्कळ लोक अगदी त्यांची मनापासून उपासना करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: ram and krishna and the other avatars knew the greatness of that limitless para- matma. Due to their worship, an ignorant man became absorbed in this knowledge (ie. ram was born an ignorant man and then he went to His guru vasistha to gain knowledge).

owis.original: सकळ देवांचे मूळ । तो हा अंतरात्माचि केवळ । भूमंडळीं भोग सकळ । त्यासीच घडे ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळ्या देवांचे मूळ असेल तर तो हा अंतरात्माच आहे. या जगामधील सारे भोग अखेर अंतरात्म्यालाच घडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Knowledge or this `I am' is the origin of the `many' gods that are worshipped. And that antar-atma (ie. the atma within everyone) is, in truth, that pure knowledge (ie. paramatma). Within the enjoyments of this gross world there is the enjoyment of this knowledge/`all' and this is the only enjoyment that the antar-atma accepts.

owis.original: नाना देव होऊन बैसला । नाना शक्तिरुपें जाला । भोक्ता सकळ वैभव । तोचि येक ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा अनेक देवांच्या रुपांनी व शक्तींच्या रुपांनीं व्यक्त होतो. सर्व प्रकारचे वैभव भोगणारा फक्त तोच एक आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But the `many' gods have been established and then this power/shakti has appeared as these `many' forms. But the enjoyer of the grandeur and glory of this `all' is that One antar-atma.

owis.original: याचा पाहावा विचार । उदंड लांबला जोजार । होती जाती देव नर । किती म्हणोनि ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा विचार नीट करुन पाहावा. देवांचे वर्णन करायचें म्हणजे फार मोठा विस्तार आहे. देव आणि माणसें किती होऊन जातात याची गणती करणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The thoughtless Self from which this `speech' has come should be understood, for due to body consciousness, this family of that paramatma has increased and grown so much. And then that One comes and goes, for God has become a man in the `many'.

owis.original: कीर्ति आणि अपकीर्ति । उदंड निंदा उदंड स्तुती । सर्वत्रांची भोगप्राप्ती । अंतरात्म्यासीच ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामध्यें होणारी कीर्ति आणि अपकीर्ति, अतिनिंदा आणि अति स्तुति, या सगळ्या गोष्टी अखेर अंतरात्म्यालाच भोगाव्या लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the pervasiveness of that vast paramatma and there is Its lack of pervasive- ness when that One takes Itself to be a body. And then that vast paramatma is either slandered or praised and It forgets that whatever is enjoyed anywhere is received by that antar-atma only.

owis.original: कोण देहीं काये करितो । कोण देहीं काये भोगितो । भोगी त्यागी वीतरागी तो । येकचि आत्मा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं देहांत तो कार्य करतो, कांहीं देहांत भोग भोगतो. भोग असो वा त्याग असो वा वीतराग असो, सर्वांचा अनुनय घेणरा तो अंतरात्मा एकच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Who is the doer of all these things in the body? Who is the enjoyer of all these things in the body? The one who enjoys, the one who renounces this enjoyment and that one who is totally detached, is the One atma only.

owis.original: प्राणी साभिमानें भुलले । देह्याकडे पाहात गेले । मुख्य अंतरात्म्यास चुकलें । अंतरीं असोनी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसें देहाभिमानाला भुलतात. आणि केवळ देहाला पाहातात. देहालाच खरेपणा देतात. त्यामुळें अंतरात्मा देहामध्यें वास करीत असून देखील त्याला चुकतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But on account of this great pride of `I am', that atma has been forgotten in the prana. And in the trust of the gross body, this understanding is completely lost. And though being Yourself that Supreme God, even that antaratma (ie. witnessing) within this inner space is missed.

owis.original: आरे या आत्मयाची चळवळ पाहे । ऐसा भूमंडळीं कोण आहे । अगाध पुण्यें अनुसंधान राहे । कांहींयेक ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अहो, या अंतरात्म्याचे कर्तेपण समजणारा व जाणणारा माणूस फारच क्वचित आढळतो. फार मोठें पुण्य गांठी असेल तर त्याचे थोडेफार अनुसंधान राखता येते.
owis.englishMeaning: My child! Who is there in this gross world who can understand this activity of that atma? And it is only due to the merit of this vivek that, there is the connection with that fathomless One who is within this `thing' (ie. concentration on That which cannot be concentrated upon).

owis.original: त्या अनुसंधानासरिसें । जळोनी जाईजे किल्मिषें । अंतरनिष्ठ ज्ञानी ऐसे । विवरोन पाहाती ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचे अनुसंधान लागल्याबरोबर पाप जळून जातें. जो अंतरनिष्ट ज्ञानी असतो तो हे सगळें नीटपणें समजतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this connection then, the sin of being a body is burnt and destroyed. Such is the inner steadfastness of the gnyani, for He is the only one who understands this `all' and keeps on investigating.

owis.original: अंतरनिष्ठ तितुके तरले । अंतरभ्रष्ट तितुके बुडाले । बाह्याकारें भरंगळले । लोकाचारें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें अंतरनिष्ट पुरुष असतात, तेवढेंच तरतात. जे अंतरभ्रष्ट असतात ते सारे बुडतात. वाया जातात. कारण बहिर्मुख लोकाचाराच्या नादी लागून ते भरमसाट वागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: One is saved by this inner steadfastness and the other drowns in a confused inner space. For if one behaves according to the world then, due to regard for the external things that one goes on guessing. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Sarvadnya Sanga Nirupan (A Discourse on the Company of the All-Knowing)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: नेणपणें जालें तें जालें । जालें तें होऊन गेलें । जाणतेपणें वर्तलें । पाहिजे नेमस्त ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण अज्ञानी असल्यानें अजाणतेपणानें आजपर्यंत जें कांहीं घडलें, तें घडून गेलें. आतां यापुढें जाणतेपणानें नीट व्यवस्थित वागावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the appearance of ignorance, that Reality has become manifest. And having appeared, That has then to disappear. Therefore this limited jiva should exist with knowingness.

owis.original: जाणत्याची संगती धरावी । जाणत्याची सेवा करावी । जाणत्याची सद्बुद्धि घ्यावी । हळुहळु ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याची संगत धरावी. त्याची सेवा करावी. त्याची सद्बुद्धि आपण हळुहळु आपलीशी करुन घ्यावी. सूक्ष्म ज्ञानदृष्टीनें अंतरात्मा पाहण्याची जी बुद्धीची स्थिती तिला सद्बुद्धि म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: One should cherish the company of the Knower (by effortless knowing, one stays in the company of the Knower). One should have the experience of the Knower. Gradually that pure buddhi of the Knower should be accepted.

owis.original: जाणत्यापासीं लेहों सिकावें । जाणत्यापासीं वाचूं सिकावें । जाणत्यापासीं पुसावें । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्यापाशी लिहायला, वाचायला शिकावें. सगळें कांहीं त्याला विचारावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should learn to `write'2 while in the company of the Knower. One should learn to `read' while in the company of the Knower. And then there should be the wiping out of this `all thing' while in the company of the Knower.

owis.original: जाणत्यास करावा उपकार । जाणत्यास झिजवावें शरीर । जाणत्याचा पाहावा विचार । कैसा आहे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्या माणसाशी उपकार करावा. त्याच्यासाठी शरीर झिझवावें. तो कसा विचार करतो तें पाहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should gain the grace of the Knower; then this `all' body will be worn away by the Knower and the thoughtlessness of the Knower will be understood.

owis.original: जाणत्याचे संगतीनें भजावें । जाणत्याचे संगतीनें झिजावें । जाणत्याचे संगतीनें रिझावें । विवरविवरों ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याच्या संगतीनें भजन करावें. दुसर्‍यासाठीं झिझावें. पुनः पुनः मनन करुन मनाला प्रसन्न करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: bhajan should be made in the company of the Knower. Great efforts should be 2From one small point of knowledge this `story/I am' should be written and then it should be properly read ie. witnessing. made to understand this bhajan that is in the company of the Knower. By constant investigation there should be the delight that is only in the company of the Knower.

owis.original: जाणत्यापासीं गांवें गाणें । जाणत्यापासीं बाजवणें । नाना आळाप सिकणें । जाणत्यापासीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्यापाशीं गाणें बजावणें शिकावें. आलाप कसें घ्यावे ते त्याच्याजवळ शिकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: This `song' should be sung in presence of the Knower. This instrument (ie. the body) should be played in the presence of the Knower. And in the presence of the Knower, the `many' thoughts should learn this harmonious tune `I am'.

owis.original: जाणत्याचे कासेसी लागावें । जाणत्याचे औषध घ्यावें । जाणता सांगेल तें करावें । पथ्य आधीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याचा आधार घ्यावा, तो सांगेल तें औषधपाणी करावें. तो सांगेल तें पथ्य करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The shelter of the Knower should be kept. The medicine of the Knower should be taken and if the Knower reveals to you that thoughtlessness at the source, then you should practice that only.

owis.original: जाणत्यापासीं परीक्षा सिकणें । जाणत्यापासीं तालिम करणें । जाणत्यापासीं पोहणें । अभ्यासावें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्यापाशी परीक्षा करायला शिकावें. त्याच्यापाशी तालीम करावी. व्यायाम शिकावा. तसेंच त्याच्यापाशीं पोहण्याचा अभ्यास करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: In the company of the Knower you should learn how to properly investigate this source (prakruti/purush). Then all physical activity should be made in the presence of the Knower. In the presence of the Knower, you should learn how to swim over this worldly ocean.

owis.original: जाणता बोलेल तैसें बोलावें । जाणता सांगेल तैसें चालावें । जाणत्याचें ध्यान घ्यावें । नाना प्रकारीं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणता जसें बोलतों तसें बोलायला शिकावें. तो सांगेल तसें आपण वागावें. तो जसें ध्यान करतो तसें ध्यान करण्याचा प्रयत्न आपण करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever the Knower `speaks', this you should `speak' and when the Knower explains thoughtlessness to you then, you should perform that only. The meditation of that Knower within these ways of the `many' should be your meditation.

owis.original: जाणत्याच्या कथा सिकाव्या । जाणत्याच्या युक्ति समजाव्या । जाणत्याच्या गोष्टी विवराव्या । सकळ कांहीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याच्या कथा शिकाव्या. त्याच्या युक्त्या समजून घ्याव्या. त्याच्या सगळ्या गोष्टींचे विवरण करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: This `story' of the Knower should be learnt. This `art' of the Knower should be understood. This `all thing' is the `story' being told by that Knower and this should be carefully investigated until you meet that Knower.

owis.original: जाणत्याचे पेंच जाणावे । जाणत्याचे पीळ उकलावे । जाणता राखेल तैसे राखावे । लोक राजी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणता पेच कसें घालतो तें समजून घ्यावें. त्याचे पीळ उकलावे. तो लोकांना जसें खूष ठेवतो तसें आपण पण लोकांना खूष ठेवावे.
owis.englishMeaning: The trick (ie. forgetting) of the Knower should be learnt (maharaj- understanding is a trick...a change of mind is required). The aloofness of the Knower should be under- stood. When that which the Knower protects is kept protected then, this `other world' is content.

owis.original: जाणत्याचे जाणावे प्रसंग । जाणत्याचे घ्यावे रंग । जाणत्याचे स्फूर्तीचे तरंग । अभ्यासावे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्यावर आलेले प्रसंग ओळखावें. निरनिराळ्या प्रसंगांत त्याचे वागण्याचे प्रकार शिकून घ्यावें. त्याला जी स्फूर्ति येते तिचा सर्वांगीण अभ्यास करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The connection of the Knower should be known. The splendour of the Knower should be accepted. And this arising inspiration of that Knower should be studied.

owis.original: जाणत्याचा साक्षेप घ्यावा । जाणत्याचा तर्कजाणावा । जाणत्याचा उल्लेख समजावा । न बोलतांचि ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याचा प्रयत्न करण्याचा स्वभाव घ्यावा. त्याची विचारपद्धती समजून घ्यावी. आणि त्याच्या शब्दांवरुन त्यानें न सांगतांच त्याचा सगळा भावार्थ समजून घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: That steadfast purpose of the Knower should be accepted. The logic of the Knower should be known (maharaj- how can you be that which is changing every moment?). And this `I am' utterance of the Knower should be understand and then afterwards not `spoken'.

owis.original: जाणत्याचें धूर्तपण । जाणत्याचें राजकारण । जाणत्याचें निरुपण । ऐकत जावें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याचे धूर्तपण व राजकारण पाहावें. त्याचे निरुपण ऐकत जावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The intelligence of the Knower should be known. The rajakarana of the Knower should be understood and the discourse of the Knower should be heard.

owis.original: जाणत्याचीं कवित्वें सिकावीं । गद्यें पद्यें वोळखावीं । माधुर्यवचनें समजावीं । अंतर्यामी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याचे कवित्व शिकावें. त्याचे गद्य व पद्य शिकून घ्यावें. त्याची मधुर वचनें आपल्या अंतर्यामीं समजावी.
owis.englishMeaning: The `poem' of the Knower should be learnt. The difference between common prose and this *inspired poem should be recognized. In this inner space the sweetness of this divine `speech' should be understood. *(See 14.3)

owis.original: जाणत्याचें पाहावें प्रबंद । जाणत्याचे वचनभेद । जाणत्याचे नाना संवाद । बरे शोधावे ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याचे प्रबंद पाहावें. त्याची निरनिराळी वचनें पाहावी. त्याचे अनेक संवाद नीट शोधून पाहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The continuous composition made by the Knower should be understood. This dis- tinct `speech' of the Knower and that best *dialogue of the Knower should be searched out by the `many' thoughts. *(The silent dialogue between the Master and disciple)

owis.original: जाणत्याची तीक्षणता । जाणत्याची सहिष्णुता । जाणत्याची उदारता । समजोन घ्यावी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याची तीक्ष्ण बुद्धी, त्याची सहनशीलता, त्याची उदारता समजून घ्यावी.
owis.englishMeaning: The alertness of the Knower, the patience of the Knower and the generosity of the Knower; that One should understand and accept.

owis.original: जाणत्याची नाना कल्पना । जाणत्याची दीर्घ सूचना । जाणत्याची विवंचना । समजोन घ्यावी ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याच्या अनेक कल्पना, त्याची दीर्घसूचना, त्याची विवंचना आपण समजून घ्यावी.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' thoughts should become the thoughtlessness of the Knower; the intimate acquaintance (ie. sagun) with the Knower and the investigation of that Knower (ie. nirgun) should be understood and accepted.

owis.original: जाणत्याचा काळ सार्थक । जाणत्याचा अध्यात्मविवेक । जाणत्याचे गुण अनेक । आवघेच घ्यावे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणता आपला काळ कसा सार्थकीं लावतो, अध्यात्माचा विवेक तो कसा करतो या गोष्टी व त्याचे अनेक गुण समजून घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The Knower fulfils His `time'3 properly, for the Knower understands the nature of vivek. Therefore the numerous different forms created by the `many' thoughts should accept this sattwa guna of the Knower.

owis.original: जाणत्याचा भक्तिमार्ग । जाणत्याचा वैराग्ययोग । जाणत्याचा अवघा प्रसंग । समजोन घ्यावा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याचा भक्तिमार्ग, त्याची वैराग्यपद्धती, निरनिराळ्या प्रसंगी त्याचे वागणें आपण समजून घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The way of devotion/bhakti of the Knower; the way of vairagya of the Knower and this connection to the Knower should be understood and accepted by the `many' thoughts.

owis.original: जाणत्याचें पाहावें ज्ञान । जाणत्याचे सिकावें ध्यान । जाणत्याचें सूक्ष्म चिन्ह । समजोन घ्यावें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणत्याचे ज्ञान पाहावें. त्याचे ध्यान शिकावें. जाणत्याच्या ज्या सूक्ष्म खूणा आहेत त्या आपण समजून घ्याव्या.
owis.englishMeaning: The knowledge of the Knower should be understood; the meditation of the Knower should be learnt and the subtle companionship with the Knower should be realized.

owis.original: जाणत्याचें अलिप्तपण । जाणत्याचें विदेहलक्षण । जाणत्याचें ब्रह्मविवरण । समजोन घ्यावें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणता अलिप्तपणें कसा राहतो, त्याच्या विदेहावस्थेचे लक्षण कोणतें, तो ब्रह्मविवरण कसेम करतो हें सगळें आपण समजून घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should understand how the Knower remains untouched; one should under- stand that attention that is beyond the body (ie. attentionless videha) and one should understand the thoughtlessness of brahman.

owis.original: जाणता येक अंतरात्मा । त्याचा काये सांगावा महिमा । विद्याकळागुणसीमा । कोणें करावी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा तेवढा खरा जाणता आहे. त्याचा महिमा सांगणें शक्य नाहीं. त्याची विद्या, कला व गुण याचा अंत कोणास लागत नाहीं. तो सत्य आहे, ज्ञानमय आहे, आणि अनंत आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That One Knower is the antaratma (ie. though ever pure still it identifies with or touches this `all'), but then how can the greatness of that paramatma be told? Who is there even who overflows with this knowledge, this `art' of knowing and the sattwa guna?

owis.original: परमेश्र्वराचे गुणानुवाद । अखंड करावा संवाद । तेणेंकरिता आनंद । उदंड होतो ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा अंतरात्मारुपी परमेश्र्वराचे गुणानुवाद करावे. त्याच्याच विषयीं सतत संभाषण करावें. असें केल्यानें अतिशय आनंद अनुभवास येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore there should be this continuously connection with that pure sattwa guna of parameshwar and then that unbroken Self should have the dialogue of Oneness. Then on account of this ananda/bliss of this `all', there is that vast paramatma.

owis.original: परमेश्र्वरें निर्मिलें तें । अखंड दृष्टीस पडतें । विवरविवरों समजावें तें । विवेकी जनीं ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमेश्र्वरानें निर्माण केलेलें हें विश्र्व सतत आपल्या दृष्टीस पडते. विवेकी माणसें जाणत्या पुरुषाकडून वारंवार विवरण करुन तें समजून घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that parameshwar creates then, that unbroken swarup has fallen into this visible `all'. But when there is continuous investigation of this `all', that Reality is understood by the viveki who is within the people (within each jiva there is the power of vivek).

owis.original: जितुकें कांहीं निर्माण जालें । तितुकें जगदेश्र्वरें निर्मिलें । निर्माण वेगळें केलें । पाहिजे आधीं ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें कांहीं निर्माण झालें आहे, तें तें सगळें जगदीश्र्वरानें निर्माण केलें आहे. पण ते जगनिर्मात्या जगदीश्र्वराहून निराळें आहे. हें प्रथम कळलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: Whenever this `thing' is created then, it is created by that Lord of the world/purush and it is at the source that this separation has taken place (taking yourself to be a body, you feel you are a separate individual; but understand that separateness, though very subtle, is at the root; you are the purush separate from whatever is seen or perceived and created).

owis.original: तो निर्माण करतो जना । परी पाहों जातां दिसेना । विवेकबळें अनुमाना । आणीत जावा ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो लोकांना निर्माण करतो, हें खरें. पण तो सूक्ष्म असल्यानें पाहूं गेल्यास दृष्टीस पडत नाहीं. म्हणून विवेकाच्या शक्तीनें त्याला आपण आपल्या कल्पनेंच्या कक्षेंत आणावा.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush is the creator and He has become a man; and then he tries to see Himself but He cannot be seen (ie. taking himself as a man, He cannot know Himself). Therefore determined and constant vivek should be brought to his conjecture (only by leaving off the thought that "I am somebody". can there be vivek).

owis.original: त्याचें अखंड लागतां ध्यान । कृपाळुपणें देतो आशन । सर्वकाळ संभाषण । तदांशेंचि करावें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्म्याचे जर अखंड ध्यान लागलें तर तो कृपाळूपणानें योगक्षेम चालवतो. खायला प्यायला घालतो. साधकाला जें जें कांहीं बोलायचे असेल तें तें त्यानें अंतरात्म्याच्या अनुसंधाने बोलावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When you make the meditation of that unbroken atma then, by His Grace, He gives everything required (let whatever come, come; He knows what I need better that I can know). Therefore there should be this `time of the all' and your conversation should be with that purush only.

owis.original: ध्यान धरीना तो अभक्त । ध्यान धरील तो भक्त । संसारापासुनी मुक्त । भक्तांस करी ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो ध्यान धरीत नाही, तो अभक्त होय. तर जो ध्यान धरतो तो भक्त होय. अंतरात्मा आपल्या भक्ताला संसारांतून मोकळा करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When this meditation is not firmly held then, you are a non-devotee and when this meditation is established then, that you are a devotee (ie. to be one with) and are liberated from this worldly existence.

owis.original: उपासनेचे सेवटीं ॥ देवां भक्तां अखंड भेटी । अनुभवी जाणेल गोष्टी । प्रत्ययाची ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उपासना करतां करतां देवाची व भक्ताची अखंड ऐक्यता होते. ही अनुभवाची गोष्ट आहे. अनुभवी लोकच तें जाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: At the end of this worship, the God and his devotee have unbroken union. Only the `experienced' will come to know that nirgun understanding that is within this `I am'. Note: In the company of the Knower means, to effortlessly know. maharaj- He is not anything that you can see or perceive with the mind, but still He is there. .

owis.original: दुल्लभ शरीरीं दुल्लभ आयुष्य । याचा करुं नये नास । दास म्हणे सावकास । विवेक पाहावा ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाचा देह मिळणें दुर्लभ असते. त्यांत आयुष्य मिळणें दुर्लभ असते. म्हणून त्याचा नाश करुं नये. श्रीरामदास म्हणतात स्वस्थपणें विचार करुन पाहावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Misfortune lies within this `all' body (ie. when that One gains the body of a jiva) and then this life is a misfortune, for it is far from the atma. Therefore the destruction of this `speech' should never happen. ramdas says, "Effortless vivek should be understood."

owis.original: न पाहातां उत्तम विवेक । आवघा होतो अविवेक । अविवेकें प्राणी रंक । ऐसा दिसे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसानें नीटपणें विचार केला नाहीं, तर सारा अविचार होतो. विवेकहीन माणूस दीन बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you do not understand such vivek then, there is a-vivek (body consciousness and no discrimination) and `many' things appear. And due to a-vivek, there is a beggar who sees in the prana ("I want this because it will make me happy").

owis.original: हे आपले आपण केलें । आळसें उदास नागविलें । वाईट संगतीनें बुडविलें । देखत देखतां ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असें घडून येण्याला आपलें आपणच कारण असतो. उदासीन वृत्तीचा माणूस आळसानें नागवला जातो. वाईट संगतीनें माणूस पाहातां पाहातां बुडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Thoughtless detachment is of your own making. But due to laziness, detachment is plundered and by the bad company of the body, this detachment gets drowned before your very eyes.

owis.original: मूर्खपणाचा अभ्यास जाला । बाश्कलपणें घातला घाला । काम चांडाळ उठिला । तरुणपणीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूर्खोपणा अंगवळणी पडला, पोरकटपणानें वागूं लागला, तरुणपण आल्यानें कामवासना बळावली,
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is the study of foolishness and due to wild and wilful behaviour, the mind is filled with distress and in our immaturity, impure desires arise.

owis.original: मूर्ख आळसी आणी तरुणा । सर्वांविषीं दैन्यवाणा । कांहीं मिळेना कोणा । काये म्हणावें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा प्रकारचा मूर्ख, आळशी आणि तरुण सर्व बाबतींत दैन्यवाणा बनतो. त्याला कांहीं मिळवतां येत नाहीं. याला काय म्हणावें?
owis.englishMeaning: When there is foolishness, laziness and such immaturity then, this `all' becomes a destitute lonely body. If this `thing' is not met then, so much will be said by so `many'.

owis.original: जें जें पाहिजे तें तें नाहीं । अन्नवस्त्र तेंहि नाहीं । उत्तम गुण कांहींच नाहीं । अंतर्यामी ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीवनाला जें जें आवश्यक आहे, त्यापैकीं कांहींच त्याच्याजवळ नसतें. त्याच्यापाशी धड अन्न वस्त्र नसतें. त्याच्या अंतर्यामीं उत्तम गुण वगैरे कांहींच नसतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that which is needed is not received and that Reality and the *essentials of life even are not acquired. Then there is not this pure sattwa guna or `thing' within. *(This food of `I am' and the covering of this `all')

owis.original: बोलता येना बैसतां येना । प्रसंग कांहींच कळेना । शरीर मन हे कळेना । अभ्यासाकडे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नीट बोलतां येत नाहीं. बसता येत नाहीं. प्रसंग वगैरे कांहींच कळत नाहीं, शरीर आणी मन अभ्यासाकडे वळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When the connection to this `thing' is not understood then you cannot `speak' nor can you be established in its delight. Then this `all' body and mind turn away from the study of that thoughtless swarup.

owis.original: लिहिणें नाहीं वाचणें नाहीं । पुसणें नाहीं सांगणें नाहीं । नेमस्तपणाचा अभ्यास नाहीं । बाष्कळपणं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लिहिणें नाहीं, वाचनें नाहीं, कोणाला विचारणें नाहीं किंवा सांगणें नाहीं. पोरकटपणानें नियमितपणाचा अभ्यास नाहीं, अशी त्याची दयनीय अवस्था असते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is no proper `writing' and no proper `reading'. The `many' thoughts are not wiped out and thoughtlessness is not there. Then due to wilful, unrestrained behaviour, there is not that skill of restraint.

owis.original: आपणास कांहींच येना । आणी सिकविलेंहि मानेना । आपण वेडा आणी सज्जना । बोल ठेवी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वतःला कांहींच येत नसतें. अणि जर कोणीं शिकवूं लागलें तर तेंहि आवडत नाहीं. असा माणूसआपण वेडा असतो आणि सज्जनांचा मात्र तो उगीच दोष देतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this `thing' cannot come to you and the learning of this is also not valued. Then one is `mad after the world' and can only slander the sajjana/Saint.

owis.original: अंतरी येक बाहेर एक । ऐसा जयाचा विवेक । परलोकाचें सार्थक । कैंसे घडे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनांत एक व जनांत एक असा त्याचा विवेक असतो. त्याच्या हातून परलोकाचे सार्थक किंवा परमार्थ कसा घडणार?
owis.englishMeaning: There is the One purush within this inner space and there is the other outside (ie. `I am'). This is the vivek of mula maya. And if this `world beyond' is not merged in no-otherness then, how can life's meaning be accomplished? (In truth, there is neither inside nor outside, but mula maya is this birth of duality. This subtle separation has created a hidden witness inside and a witnessed outside. It is said to be hidden because it cannot be known; for that is you)

owis.original: आपला संसार नासला । मनामधें प्रस्तावला । तरी मग अभ्यास केला । पाहिजे विवेकाचा ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें संसारांत फसगत झाल्यावर माणसाच्या मनाला पश्र्चाताप होतो.मग त्यानें विवेकाचा अभ्यास करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: But if your samsar is destroyed and in the mind there is repentance then, there can be this skill of vivek.

owis.original: येकाग्र करुनियां मन । बळेंचि धरावें साधन । येत्नीं आळसाचें दर्शन । होऊंच नये ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा माणसानें मन एकाग्र करावें. आणि जबरदस्तीनें परमार्थ साधना करण्यास लागावें. आपल्या प्रयत्नामध्यें चुकूनसुद्धा आळसाचा शिरकाव होऊं देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: To make the mind one-pointed there should be ever steadfast practice. In these efforts not even the sight of laziness should be allowed.

owis.original: अवगुण अवघेचि सांडावें । उत्तम गुण अभ्यासावे । प्रबंद पाठ करीत जावे । जाड अर्थ ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या अंगचे सगळे अवगुण सोडावें. उत्तम गुणांचा अभ्यास करावा. ग्रंथ पाठ करावें. आणि त्यांतील मोठा व खोल अर्थ ध्यानांत धरावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The wrong gunas (ie. objectification) and the `many' things should be left and the best guna should be studied. And then, there will be the continuous support of that innermost meaning.

owis.original: पदप्रबंद श्र्लोकप्रबंद । नाना धाटी मुद्रा छंद । प्रसंगज्ञानेंचि आनंद । होत आहे ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना प्रकारची रचना असलेले श्लोक आणि पदें, तसेंच अनेक धाटी, मुद्रा आणि छंद पाठ करावे. योग्य प्रसंगी त्यांचा उचित उपयोग केला तर सर्वांना आनंद होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this continual state and this continual meeting when the `many' thoughts are fixed upon this goal and the mind is full of eagerness and the longing for the Truth. Then due to this connection with knowledge, ananda/bliss appears.

owis.original: कोणे प्रसंगीं काये म्हणावें । ऐसें समजोन जाणावें । उगेंचि वाऊगें सिणावें । कासयासी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणत्या प्रसंगीं काय म्हणणें योग्य आहे हे बरोबर समजून असावें. उगीच व्यर्थ गैरलागू म्हणण्यांत केवळ शीण होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: What should this `all' say in this `all'? Such should be understood and known (you are this `all' and you should say nothing, for this `all' should not break its praise and connection with Its own self. You should leave the concepts and imaginings that you have yourself created and just effortlessly know). And why should that still and silent Self be troubled by the false (this `all' is also false and is a trouble to that pure swarup)?

owis.original: दुसर्‍याचें अंतर जाणावें । आदर देखोन म्हणावें । जें आठवेल तें गांवें । हें मूर्खपण ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्यांचे अंतरंगांत काय आहे तें आधी ओळखावें. आपण जें म्हणतो, त्याबद्दल त्यांची उत्सुकता दिसली तरच तें म्हणावें. उगीच जें आठवेल तें गाणें किंवा म्हणणें हें मूर्खपण होय.
owis.englishMeaning: One should know this inner space of the `all'. But, if this earnest contemplation (ie. forget everything) is forced to say something (ie. remember something) or if this should sing something that has been remembered then, that thoughtless Self has become a fool (the trick is to forget each and every moment then, this is just effortless knowing. This whole world appears when you remember this thing and that thing. When you awake in the morning, you are there, nothing else and no remembering of anything is required for that; but then you remember so many things and forget yourself)

owis.original: ज्याची जैसी उपासना । तेंचि गावें चुकावेना । रागज्ञाना ताळज्ञाना । अभ्यासावें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याची जशी उपासना असेल तेंच त्यानें गांवें. त्यामध्यें चूक करुं नये. रागाचा व तालाचा अभ्यास करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is to be the worship of that purush then, this `song' should not be neglected. When there is the knowledge of ragas (attractions and sentiments created by worldly concerns) then, that knowledge of the tala should be skilfully practiced (ie. then in every action I am in my swarup. Then everything is appearing on Myself. Anger, joy, desire etc. are all appearing on Myself)

owis.original: साहित संगीत प्रसंग मानें । करावीं कथेंचीं घमशानें । अर्थांतर श्रवणमननें । काढीत जावें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साहित्य, संगीत, योग्य प्रसंग यांचा मेळ बसवून मोठ्य धडाक्यानें कथा करावी. श्रवण, मनन करुन ग्रंथांमधील निरनिराळे अर्थ काढावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Respect for this `all' connection is the companionship of this `song' and one should revel in the telling of this `story'. By shravan and manana, the innermost meaning should be taken out (ie. nijadhyas and satkshakar).

owis.original: पाठ उदंडचि असावें । सर्वकाळ उजळीत जावें । सांगितलें गोष्टीचें असावें । स्मरण अंतरीं ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सपाटून पाठांतर असावें. सतत त्याची उजळणी करावी. जी गोष्ट सांगितली असेल तिचेअंतरी स्मरण ठेवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the support of only that vast paramatma then, this time of the `all' is kept pure. Then this `story' that is being remembered in your inner space should also be let slip and there will be One only (then this `art' of knowing/knowledge is not required).

owis.original: अखंड येकांत सेवावा । ग्रन्थमात्र धांडोळावा । प्रचित येईल तो घ्यावा । अर्थ मनीं ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरंतर एकांत सेवन करावा. एकामतामध्यें सगळें ग्रंथ सूक्ष्मपणें अभ्यासावें. आणि जोअर्थ अनुभवाला जुळेल तो ध्यानांत ठेवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The unbroken Self should search within this composition of words and relish It's own `aloneness'. That purush within the experience `I am' will come when that innermost meaning is accepted in the mind (ie. only He is and I do not exist). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Dehe Dullabha Nirupan (A Discourse on the Rarity of this Body)

owis.original: देह्याकरितां गणेशपूजन । देह्याकरिता शारदावंदन । देह्याकरितां गुरु सज्जन । संत श्रोते ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मानवदेहामुळें गणेशपूजन, शारदावंदन, गुरु, संत, सज्जन व श्रोते हे असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the body there is the puja/worship of ganesh. On account of the body, sharada is praised. On account of the body there is the guru, the sajjana, the Saint and the listener.

owis.original: देह्याकरितां कवित्वें चालती । देह्याकरितां अधेनें करिती । देह्याकरितां अभ्यासिती । नाना विद्या ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहामुळें कवित्व, अध्ययन, अनेक विद्यांचा अभ्यास या गोष्टी चालतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the body, poetry is composed. On account of the body, books are read and on account of the body, that One studies the `many' knowledges.

owis.original: देह्याकरितां ग्रंथलेखन । नाना लिपीवोळखण । नाना पदार्थशोधन । देह्याकरितां ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहामुळें ग्रंथलेखन, लिपी ओळखण, पदार्थ शोधन ही चालतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the body, this spiritual composition gets `written'. The `many' recognize that hidden atma and the `many' search for this `object', on account of the body.

owis.original: देह्याकरितां माहांज्ञानी । सिद्ध साधु ऋषी मुनी । देह्याकरितां तीर्थाटणीं । फिरती प्राणी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहामुळें महाज्ञानी, सिद्ध, साधु, ऋषि व मुनि होतात. देहामुळें लोक तीर्थाटन करुं शकतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the body, there is the great gnyani, the siddha, the sadhu, the rishi and the muni/sage. On account of the body, that One is always in this holy place while the other wanders around in the prana (when you give up your thoughts then, you are the Knower knowing this `all'/wind. Otherwise you will remain in the prana).

owis.original: देह्याकरितां श्रवण घडे । देह्याकरितां मननीण पवाडे । देह्याकरितां देहीं आतुडे । मुख्य परमात्मा ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहामुळें श्रवण घडतें. देहामुळें मनन खूप वाढतें. या देहांतच मुख्य परमात्मा आपलासा करुन घेतां येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the body, shravan is accomplished; on account of the body, manana expands; then on account of this body within the `all' body, that Supreme paramatma is met (satkshatkar).

owis.original: देह्याकरितां कर्ममार्ग । देह्याकरितां उपासनामार्ग । देह्याकरितां ज्ञानमार्ग । भूमंडळीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाच्या साहायानेंच कर्मयोग, उपासनामार्ग आणि ज्ञानमार्ग जगांत आचरता येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the body, there is the way of karma/action (`He does everything'); on account of the body, there is the way of worship/upasana (the mind that was placed with the objects is lifted out and placed with God) and on account of the body, there is this way of knowledge that is within this gross world.

owis.original: योगी वीतरागी तापसी । देह्याकरितां नाना सायासी । देह्याकरितां आत्मयासी । प्रगटणें घडे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: योगी, विरक्त आणि तापसी हे देहाच्या साहायानें अनेक कष्ट करतात. देहांतून आत्मा प्रगट होऊं शकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the yogi, the one who makes austerities and the One beyond attachment, on account of the body. On account of this body, there are the `many' great efforts and on account of this body, the atma becomes apparent.

owis.original: येहलोक आणी परलोक । देह्याकरितां सकळ सार्थक । देहेंविण निरार्थक । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इहलोक असो किंवा परलोकअसो, दोन्हीकडे या देहामुळेंच सार्थक घडतें. देहांवाचून कशालाहि कांहीं अर्थ राहात नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the gross world and this world beyond; and on account of the body, the `all' accomplishes life's meaning (ie. nirgun). Without this body, this `all thing' is meanin- gless (only through reading the scriptures and going to a Master can one learn about, Who I am and gain knowledge).

owis.original: पुरश्र्चरणें अनुष्ठानें । गोरांजनें धूम्रपानें । सीतोष्ण पंचाग्नी साधनें । देह्याकरितां ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुरश्चरणें, अनुष्ठानें, गोरांजनें, धूम्रपानें, शीतोष्ण आणि पंचाग्निसाधनें हीं सारी देहाच्या साहाय्यानें घडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The repetition of mantra, the performance of rituals, the gulping down of cow's urine and the inhalation of smoke; the enduring of the very cold and the sadhana of the `five fires' are all on account of this body.

owis.original: देह्याकरितां पुण्यसीळ । देह्याकरितां पापी केवळ । देह्याकरितां अनर्गळ । सुचिस्मंत ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस देहामुळें पुण्यशील बनतो. देहामुळेंच केवळ पापी बनतो. देहामुळेंच तो स्वैराचारी किंवा सदाचारी बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, one gains great merit (ie. to be beyond the body) and on account of this body, that pure knowledge becomes body conscious; on account of this body, there is the uncontrolled and there is the pure.

owis.original: देह्याकरितां अवतारी । देह्याकरितां वेषधारी । नाना बंडें बनतो. करी । देह्याकरितां ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या देहाच्या साहायानेंच अवतार होतात. देहानेंच नाना वेष घेतां येतात. अनेक प्रकारची बंडें आणि पाखंडें देहाकडूनच करतां येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, there is the avatar (ie. to come down into knowledge) and on account of this body, there is the holder of this disguise ("I am Mr. so and so"). The `many' pretenders and their heretical, hypocritical views are all made on account of this body.

owis.original: देह्याकरितां विषयभोग । देह्याकरितां सकळ त्याग । होती जाती नाना रोग । देह्याकरितां ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यादेहामुळें विषयभोग भोगता येतात. देहानेंच सगळ्याचा त्याग करतां येतो. देहालाच अनेक रोग होतात व बरें होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, there is the enjoyment of the sense objects; on account of this body, there is the giving up of the `all'. The disease of `many' thoughts comes and goes, on account of this body.

owis.original: देह्यकरितां नवविधा भक्ती । देह्याकरितां चतुर्विधा मुक्ती । देह्याकरिताम नाना युक्ती । नाना मतें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या देहाच्या साधनानें नवविधा भक्ति करतां येते, चार प्रकारच्या मुक्ति साधतां येतात. नाना प्रकारच्या युक्ति आणि मतें या देहामुळेंच शक्य होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, there are the nine devotions; on account of this body, there are the four types of liberation; on account of this body, there are the `many' skills and the `many' opinions.

owis.original: देह्याकरितां दानधर्म । देह्याकरितां नाना वर्म । देह्याकरितां पूर्वकर्म । म्हणती जनीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहामुळें दानधर्म करतां येतो. देहामुळें अनेक रहस्यें उलगडतात.या देहसंबंधानेंच पूर्वकर्माची भाषा लोक बोलतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, there is your dharma and the giving away of this body; on account of this body, there are the `many' sensitive matters; on account of this body, the people say, "There is our previous karma to be endured."

owis.original: देह्याकरितां नाना स्वार्थ । देह्याकरितां नाना अर्थ । देह्याकरितां होईजे वेर्थ । आणी धन्य ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या देहाच्या साधनानें अनेक स्वार्थ साधतां येतात. देहानें अनेक वस्तु प्राप्त करुन घेतां येतात. या देहाच्या साहाय्यानें माणूस वाया जातो किंवा धन्य होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, there are the `many' wealths and there is our own wealth (`I only am everywhere'); on account of this body, there is the `many' meanings and that innermost meaning; on account of this body, there will be the useless and the blessed.

owis.original: देह्याकरितां नाना कळा । देह्याकरितां उणा आगळा । देह्याकरितां जिव्हाळा । भक्तिमार्गाचा ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या देहानें अनेक कला शिकता येतात. देहामुळें उणेपणा किंवा अधिकपणा येतो. या देहामध्येंच भक्तिमार्गाचा जिव्हाळा निर्माण होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, there is the `many' arts and the `art' of knowing; on account of this body, there is the more and the less; on account of this body, there is the beginning of the way of devotion.

owis.original: नाना सन्मार्गसाधनें । देह्याकरितां तुटती बंधनें । देह्याकरितां निवेदनें । मोक्ष ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या देहानें सन्मार्गाची अनेक साधनें साध्य होतात, देहानें अनेक बंधनें तुटतात. देहाच्या साहायानें आत्मनिवेदन करुन मोक्ष साधतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' sadhanas and the True path and there is the cutting of the `many' bondages on account of this body. On account of this body, there is the attainment of liberation through the surrender of this body.

owis.original: देहे सकळामधें उत्तमु । देहीं राहीला आत्मारामु । सकळां घटीं पुरुषोत्तमु । विवेकी जाणती ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मानवदेह सर्व देहांत उत्तम देह आहे. या देहामध्यें अंतरात्मा वास करतो. सर्व देहांमध्यें पुरुषोत्तम आहे. ही गोष्ट विवेकी पुरुष जाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the body within this `all' body, there is that best pure sattwa guna and within this body that purush resides. In this small vessel (ie. gross body), this `all' body and that atmaram are known by the viveki.

owis.original: देह्याकरितां नाना कीर्ती । अथवा नाना अपकीर्ती । देह्याकरितां होती जाती । अवतारमाळिका ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या देहानें उत्तम प्रकारची कीर्ति किंवा अनेक प्रकारें अपकीर्ति होऊं शकते. या देहाच्या आधारानेंच अनेक अवतारांची मालिका होऊन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, the `many' becomes pervasive or the `many' has no per- vasiveness. On account of this body, the Master of this avatar comes and goes (the Master is the purush and the avatar is the `all'/prakruti)

owis.original: देह्याकरितां नाना भ्रम । देह्याकरितां नाना संभ्रम । देह्याचेन उत्तमोत्तम । भोगिती पदें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या देहामुळें अनेक भ्रम होतात. तसेंच अनेक मोह होतात. या देहाच्या साहायानेंच अति उत्तम पदांचा भोग घेतां येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, there are the `many' confusions and on account of this body, there are the `many' admirations and acclaims. On account of this body, the best of the best is enjoyed (ie. parabrahman).

owis.original: देह्याकरितां सकळ कांहीं । देह्याविण कांहीं नाहीं । आत्मा विरे ठाईं ठाईं । नव्हता जैसा ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या दृश्य जगामध्यें मानव देहामुळें सगळें कांहीं साध्य करुन घेतां येते. हा देह नसेल तर कांहींच साधतां येत नाहीं. देहांतून प्रगट होणारा आत्मा देहाच्या अभावीं जेथल्या तेथें नाहींसा होऊन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, this `all thing' can be understood; but without this body, this `thing' is not. And if this `thing' is not known then, that atma disappears from this place of the `all' and it is as if It was never there.

owis.original: देहे परलोकींचें तारुं । नाना गुणांचा गुणागरु । नाना रत्नांचा विचारु । देह्याचेनी ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा देह जणूं काय परमार्थाचें तारु आहे, तो अनेक गुणांचे आश्रयस्थान आहे. या देहानेंच जगांतील अनेक रत्नांचा विचार करतां येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This body is the ferry boat to the world beyond. This body is the abode of the `many' gunas and on account of this body, the *`many' jewels become that most precious jewel of thoughtlessness. *(On account of body consciousness we put many different values on `many' different things).

owis.original: देह्याचेन गायेनकळा । देह्याचेन संगीतकळा । देह्याचेन अंतर्कळा । ठांई पडे ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाच्या साहायानेंच गायनकला व संगीतकला शिकतां येतात. अंतर्यामीवास करणारी जीवनकला, देहाच्या साहायानें हस्तगत होते.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body, there is the art of `singing' and on account of this body, there is the art of `music and dance'. On account of this body, the `art' of the inner space is discovered (ie. forget everything and effortlessly know).

owis.original: देहे ब्रह्मांडाचे फळ । देहे दुल्लभचि केवळ । परी या देह्यास निवळ । उमजावें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा देह म्हणजे या ब्रह्मांड वृक्षाचे सर्वोत्तम फळ आहे. मानव देह अत्यंत दुर्लभ आहे. पण या देहाला अगदी शाहाणें करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: This body is the *fruit of the brahmanda. This body is truly a great misfortune and yet it becomes that pure knowledge (through understanding). Still if that pure knowledge is to be understood then, this body should merge within this `I am' body. *(Yet within this fruit there is this seed `I am' of the gross creation/brahmanda)

owis.original: देह्याकरितां लाहानथोर । करिती अपुलाले व्यापार । त्याहिमधें लाहानथोर । कितीयेक ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामधील लहानमोठी माणसें देहाच्या साहाय्यानेंच आपापली कर्में करतात. त्या कर्मांच्यामध्यें लहान कर्में व मोठी कर्में असा भेद असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this body there is the small jiva within that great brahman and on account of that jiva there is the performance of so much work and business. But in this small within the great, there is also that One within the `many' (ie. both are within each other; the one you choose is up to you).

owis.original: जे जे देहे धरुनी आले । ते ते कांहीं करुन गेले । हरिभजनें पावन जाले । कितीयेक ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें जीव देह धारण करुन येतात, ते ते सर्व जीव कांहींतरी कर्में करुन जातात. त्यापैकीं कितीतरी जीव भगवंताच्या भजनानें पावन होऊन गेलें.
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya holds this body then, the `thing' that was created gets destroyed. Still due to the bhajans of hari (ie. to forget everything and know) that One within the `many' is purified.

owis.original: अष्टधा प्रकृतीचे मूळ । संकल्परुपचि केवळ । नाना संकल्पें देहेफळ । घेऊन आलें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगदी पहिला जो संकल्प उठला तोच अष्टधा प्रकृतीचे मूळ आहे. त्या मूळ संकल्पांतून जे अगदी छोटे छोटे संकल्प निर्माण होतात, त्यांचें दृश्य फळ देहांच्या रुपानें दिसते.
owis.englishMeaning: The beginning of this eight-fold prakruti was when that pure knowledge had the desire to know. Then on account of this desire to know, its fruit, the gross body also appeared and was accepted.

owis.original: हरिसंकल्प मुळीं होता । तोचि फळीं पाहावा आतां । नाना देह्यांतरीं तत्वता । शोधितां कळे ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगदी प्रथम जें मूळ स्फूरण आहे, तेंच जगामधील अनेक मानव देहांमध्यें पाहाणें योग्य आहे. अनेक देहांच्या अंतर्यामीं शोधून पाहिलें तर तो मूळ संकल्प दृष्टोपत्तीस येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Understand this desire of vishnu at the root and then only that atma that is within this fruit can be understood. Therefore the `many' (ie. mind) should be thoroughly searched through and that atma within this inner space (ie. seed) should be unders- tood.

owis.original: वेलाचे मुळीं बीज । उदकरुप वेली समज । पुढें फळामधें बीज । मुळींच्या अंशें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या वेलाच्या मुळांत बीज असतें. नंतर वेलाची वाढ होत जाते. ती वाढ सारी उदकरुपच असते. पण अखेर वेलाला जें फळ येते. त्याच्यामध्यें मूळाच्या अंशांतून आलेलें बीज आढळतें. त्याचप्रमाणें माणूस हा विश्ववेलाचा सर्वोत्तम फळ असल्यानें त्याच्या अंतर्यामीं विश्वाचा मूळ संकल्प प्रकर्षानें दृष्टीस पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The root of the creeper ("I am a body" thoughts) is this seed `I am'. And if you understand that the creeper is the sprouting of this seed and it is formed by these waters of objectification (the creeper grows when there are these waters of objectification and it requires these waters to stay in this world. Therefore if you stop objectifying, this creeper will dry up and only the seed will remain), then afterwards you will be this seed within the fruit and a part of the root (then you will be this prakruti within her atma purush).

owis.original: मुळाकरितां फळ येतें । फळाकरितां मूळ होतें । येणेंकरितां होत जाते । भूमंडळ ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणत्याही वृक्षाचे मूळ त्याच्या बीजामध्यें असते. त्या बीजामधून वृक्षाची वाढ होऊन अखेर त्यास फळें येतात. या फळांमध्यें मूळचे बीज प्रगट होते. अगदी याच पद्धतीनें जगामध्यें सर्व घटना होतात व जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the root, the fruit appears and on account of the fruit, this root is understood. However because of the fruit, there is this world that comes and goes (ie. when you awake this world appears and when you go to sleep, this world disappears).

owis.original: असो कांहीं येक करणें । कैसें घडे देह्याविणें । देहे सार्थकीं लावणें । म्हणिजे बरें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो, कांहीं जर करायचे असेल तर तें देहाशिवाय करतां येत नाहीं. म्हणून देह सार्थकी लावणें हेच योग्य आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: How can this action (`all') by the One be accomplished without this body? On account of this body, the meaning of life is revealed and you become thoughtless.

owis.original: आत्म्याकरितां देहे जाला । देह्याकरितां आत्मा तगला । उभययोगें उदंड चालिला । कार्यभाग ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा धारण करण्यासाठीं देह जन्मतो. देहाच्या योगानें आत्मा तगतो. दोघांच्या योगानें जगांत फार मोठे कार्य घडून येते.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the atma, this body appears and on account of this body, the atma Discourse on the Body has a place to stay. By the union of both, that paramatma moves and does everything (by means of this `all').

owis.original: चोरुन गुप्तरुपें करावें । तें आत्मयासी पडे ठावें । कर्तुत्व याचेन स्वभावें । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगदी चोरुन आणि गुप्तपणें जरी आपण कांहीं केलें तरी तें अंतरात्म्याला कळते. सगळें कर्तृत्व अखेर स्वाभाविकपणें अंतरात्म्याचेंच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This gross body should be covered over by this `all' body of that hidden atma (ie. this body should merge in the `all' body) and then this `all' can find that atma. Therefore understand that this power of doing is due to this spontaneous `all thing' and not the gross body.

owis.original: देह्यामधें आत्मा असतो । देहे पूजितां आत्मा तोषतो । देहे पिडीतां आत्मा क्षोभतो । प्रतक्ष आता ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा देहामध्यें राहातो. देहाची पूजा केल्यानें आत्मा संतोष पावतो. देहाला दुःख दिलें तर आत्म्याचा क्षोभ होतो. हा तर प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma resides within this body and when you make *puja with this body, that atma is pleased. However you only bring trouble to this body when you see through the senses ("I know this and I want that") and then the atma is disturbed. *(siddhara- meshwar maharaj- puja means to know)

owis.original: देह्यावेगळी पूजा पावेना । देह्याविण पूजा फावेना । जनीं जनार्दन म्हणोनी जना । संतुष्ट करावें ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाच्या अभावी आत्म्याला पूजा पावत नाहीं. देहाच्या अभावी आत्म्याची पूजा करतां येत नाहीं. सगळ्या जनांत जनार्दन भरलेला आहे, म्हणून जनांना संतुष्ट करावें. त्यानेंच परमात्मा संतोष पावतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This puja/worship is not possible except with the body and without the body this puja cannot be gained (forgetting everything and remaining in this knowing is puja/worship). The atma is within the man and therefore this man should make Him happy (the man/mind should forget he is a man and just know).

owis.original: उदंड प्रगटला विचार । धर्मस्थापना तदनंतर । तेथेंच पूजेस अधिकार । पुण्यशरीरीं ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या देहामध्यें थोर विचार पुष्कळ प्रमाणांत प्रगट होतात आणि ज्या देहाकडून नंतर आत्मज्ञानाचा प्रसार होतो, तो देह पुण्यमय असतो. त्याला पूजा घेण्याचा अधिकार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless paramatma manifests then, there is the establishment of your dharma (ie. to be knowledge). But in truth, only that atma `there' within this auspicious `all' body, is worthy of worship.

owis.original: सगट भजन करुं येतें । तरी मूर्खपण आंगीं लागतें । गाढवासी पूजितां कळतें । काये त्याला ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळ्यांनाच सरसगट आपण पूज्य मानूं लागलो, तर आपल्या अंगी मूर्खपण लागते. उदा. जर आपण एखाद्या गाढवाची पूजा केली तर त्यांत त्याला काहींच कळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If you make your bhajans to this world of `many' things then, within this `all' body there is a fool. It is no better than making puja/worship to a donkey and how then, will that paramatma be understood? (ie. when you love and worship this body, how can you know the Self?

owis.original: पूज्य पूजेसी अधिकार । उगेचि तोषवावे इतर । दुखऊं नये कोणाचें अंतर । म्हणिजे बरें ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो पूज्य असेल त्याला पूजा घेण्याचा खरा अधिकार असतो. पण इतर माणसांना मान देऊन संतुष्ट ठेवावें. कुणाचे मन न दुखावणें हें केव्हांही चांगलेच.
owis.englishMeaning: That which is worthy of puja/worship should be worshipped and in this way, the mind should make that still and silent Self happy. And when even the inner space of this `all' is not known then, there is thoughtlessness.

owis.original: सकळ जगदांतरींचा देव । क्षोभता राहाव्या कोठें ठाव । जनावेगळा जनास उपाव । आणीक नाहीं ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगदंतरी सगळीकडे भरलेला अंतरात्मा जर क्षोभला तर जगामध्यें राहायला जागा राहणार नाहीं. माणसांशिवाय माणसाचें जीवन चालणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this `all' and there is that God residing within this `all' (prakruti and purush). If He becomes angry (if He becomes a man/body conscious) then, how can one stay in this place of the `all'? (You are knowledge. When you awake in the morning, knowledge awakes. But as soon as you begin thinking the `many' thoughts and do not remain detached, you become conscious of a body. Then your mind fills with desires and when you do not get what you want, anger arises. Then you want something other than just to know and this understanding of the `all' has slipped away) Then other than remaining in this world there is no refuge but this world (ie. then you cannot even think of a world other than this world and the refuge of this `other world'/knowledge cannot be gained).

owis.original: परमेश्र्वराचे अनंत गुण । मनुष्यें काये सांगावी खूण । परंतु अध्यात्मग्रंथश्रवण । होतां उमजे ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमेश्र्वराचे अक्षरशः अगणित गुण आहेत. माणसाला त्याच्या संपूर्ण खाणाखुणा सांगतां येणें शक्य नाहीं. पण अध्यात्मग्रंथांचें श्रवण केलें तर थोडे कांहीं परमात्मस्वरुप आकलन होते.
owis.englishMeaning: How can a man understand this pure sattwa guna and the endlessness of that parameshwara? Still, if you listen to this spiritual composition then, that understanding will come (for that man will become knowledge). . you choose to use them. "I am the body and all the actions performed through these five organs of knowledge and five organs of action are to gain pleasure." When your concept is like this then this is called a worldly existence. The one with understanding knows, `I am not the body. I stay in the body but I am the Master of all the organs that work in association with this body. I reside within these organs of the body and through them I perform every action.' To see, to hear, to taste, to smell, to feel, to think and to imagine These are all actions of this being-ness and they have but one meaning and that is - to know! This unique `art of knowing' is your being-ness and when this is clearly perceived in every action then, this is called devotion/bhajan to that Supreme Self and through this devotion that Ultimate Accomplishment is achieved. Whatever may be the condition of the body or the actions of the body still, you do not change and if by constantly remaining in this experience of knowing your own existence within the body and the body's actions then, you will see yourself in every body and in every action of everybody. This is proper devotion/bhajan to the Lord. Discourse on the Body

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Karant Pariksha Nirupan (A Discourse on Testing the Unfortunate)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: धान्य उदंड मोजिलें । परी त्या मापें नाहीं भक्षिलें । विवरल्याविण तैसें जालें । प्राणीमात्रासी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा, एखाद्या मापानें खूप धान्य मोजलें. तें माप कांहीं तें धान्य खात नाहीं. त्याचप्रमाणें जो माणूस विचार करीत नाहीं, त्यास त्याच्या ज्ञानाचा कांहीं उपयोग होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Even a grain of rice is that vast paramatma when it is regarded as such. But that paramatma has not been regarded and so It has been destroyed. In this way, without investigation, that paramatma appears in the prana only (when that thoughtless para- matma is understood, then everything, everywhere, even a grain of rice, is Him. But if there is no vivek then, He will not recognize Himself and He remains with body consciousness)

owis.original: पाठ म्हणतां आवरेना । पुसतां कांहींच कळेना । अनुभव पाहातां अनुमाना- । मधें पडें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका माणसाचें मोठें पाठांतर होतें. एकदाका तो पाठ म्हणूं लागला कीं, त्याला तें आवरत नसे. पण त्याचा अर्थ विचारला तर त्याला कांहींच कळत नव्हतें. त्याचा अनुभव पाहिला तर तो केवळ कल्पना करतो असें आढळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then you are calling this superficial covering (ie. the gross body), paramatma and do not even gather together the `many' things into this `thing'. And even if this `thing' is understood still, it does not get wiped out (by vignyan). If you only understand this `experience' then, somewhere in-between you will again fall into conjecture and guesswork (ie. the conviction that these `many' forms and even this `all' form are totally false, has not been established and there is a wavering mind; it understands one moment and the next it is washed away in this flood of maya).

owis.original: शब्दरत्नें परीक्षावीं । प्रत्ययाचीं पाहोन घ्यावीं । येर ते अवघीं सांडावीं । येकीकडे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ग्रंथ वाचतांना त्यांतील शब्दांची नीट परीक्षा करावी. त्यामध्यें जी स्वानुभवाची वचनें असतील ती ग्रहण करावी. बाकीचा ग्रंथ बाजूस सोडावा. तो ग्रहण करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That One should carefully examine this world with this jewel of the `word' (`I am') and then that understanding of the nirgun Self should be accepted. Therefore the mind seated within the `many' things should be lifted out and placed near that Reality.

owis.original: नांवरुप आवघें सांडावें । मग अनुभवास मांडावें । सार असार येकचि करावें । हें मूर्खपण ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नामरुपांनीं भरलेलें दृश्य सगळें मागें टाकावें. आणि मग अनुभवाच्या मागें लागावें. दृश्य हें असार आहे. अदृश्य अंतरात्मा सार आहे. सार व असार दोन्हीं एकच करणें मूर्खपणाचें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This `name' (`I am'/existence/sat) and `form' (`all'/knowledge/chid) should set aside the `many' things and this `experience' should be firmly established. But if that essence and this non-essence are taken to be the same then, that thoughtless Self is still being foolish (ie. this knowledge cannot be taken as beyond knowledge/vignyan).

owis.original: लेखकें कुळ समजवावें । किंवा उगेंच वाचावें । येणें दृष्टांतें समजावें । कोणींतरी ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो मजकूर लिहिलेला आहे तो लेखकानें कुळाला बरोबर समजावून सांगावा. जें लिहिलेलें नाहीं तें म्हणजे उगीच कांहींतरी वाचूं नये. या दृष्टांतावरुन प्रत्येकानें योग्य काय ते नीट समजावें,
owis.englishMeaning: Either you should be the `writer' of this `word' and understand this `all', or that still and silent Self should be the `reader'/witness of this `all' (either understand you are the doer everywhere or He is the doer, but leave this body consciousness; maharaj- faith in yourself is best). In this way, that One within the inner space should understand the `end of the visible' (`all').

owis.original: जेथें नाहीं समजावीस । तेथें आवघी कुसमुस । पुसों जातां वसवस । वक्ता करी ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला एखादा ग्रंथ लोकांना नीट समजावून सांगता येत नाहीं, त्याच्या सांगण्यामुळें लोक नाराज होतात. आणि वक्त्याला प्रश्र्ण विचारायला गेलें तर तो वसकन् अंगावर येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This mula maya should be understood, otherwise that brahman is lost within the `many' things and there is only crying and turmoil. Then the `speaker' should wipe out this fanciful notion of `I am' (the `speaker' understands thoughtlessness).

owis.original: नाना शब्द येकवटिले । प्रचीतीवीण उपाव केले । परी ते अवघेचि वेर्थ गेले । फडप्रसंगीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा माणूस पुष्कळ शब्द बोलला पण त्याच्यामधें प्रचितीचें कांहींच नसेल तर पुष्कळ लोक जमलेले असले तरी त्याचें सगळें बोलणें वाया जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' words and this `word' have all been jumbled together and then there are these `many' remedies that are void of this `experience' and that Reality has become these useless transactions by the people of this world.

owis.original: पसेवरी वैरण घातलें । तांतडीनें जातें वोडिलें । तेणें पीठ बारीक आलें । हे तों घडेना ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जसें कीं, जात्यावर दळण एखाद्यानें भासाभस वैरण-धन्य घातलें आणि भराभर जातें फिरवलें तर पीठ बारीक येणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If many grains are placed between two grinding stones and the grinder is rotated too fast then, does this make the flour fine? In the same way, if the mind is always busy then, that thoughtless paramatma cannot be understood. (The mind is like the grinder and if it does not rush here and there and is used for vivek then, the grain can be properly ground ie. properly understood and one will come to understand that everything is that paramatma, see V.1)

owis.original: घांसामागें घांस घातला । आवकाश नाहीं चावायाला । अवघा बोकणा भरिला । पुढें कैसें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किंवा एखादा माणूस जेवायला बसला आणि त्यानें एकामागून एक घासावर घास तोंडांत घातलें. घास चावायलाही तो थांबला नाहीं, नुसता बोकाणाच भरला, तर तें अन्न नीट पचत नाहीं. पुष्कळ शिकतच गेला, पन त्यावर चिंतन, मनन न केल्यानें त्याला तें ज्ञान नीट आत्मसात करतां येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: If you put morsel after morsel in your mouth and do not leave any space for chewing then, there is simply a mouth overfull of everything and ahead what will happen? (Proper thinking and churning is required otherwise you will suffer)

owis.original: ऐका फडनिसीचें लक्षण । विरंग जाऊं नेदी क्षण । समस्तांचें अंतःकर्ण । सांभाळीत जावें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फडणीसाचे मुख्य लक्षण असें कीं, तो कोणत्याही प्रसंगीं बेरंग होऊ देत नाहीं. म्हणून सर्वांचे अंतःकरण सांभाळीत जावें. फडणीस म्हणजे प्रतिनीधी. येथें वक्ता हा संतांचा प्रतिनिधी समजावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Carefully listen! Your attention should be like the one who takes care of accounts. Your interest should not fade for even a moment and your knowing antah-karana should be ever vigilant and carefully watch over these `many' things.

owis.original: सूक्ष्म नामें सुखें घ्यावीं । तितुकीं रुपें वोळखावीं । वोळखोन समजवावीं । श्रोतयांसी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अध्यात्माचें विवेचन करतांना सूक्ष्म तत्वांची नांवें वापरावीत. पण आपण जें शब्द वापरतो त्यांचा अर्थ आणि त्या शब्दांनीं दर्शविलेल्या तत्वांचे स्वरुप आपल्याला बरोबर माहीत असावें. आपण तें जाणून श्रोत्यांना समजावून द्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: By means of this `word', you should accept the happiness that is with brahman alone. That One should be recognised from His `form' and having been recognized, the listener should be made to understand that nirgun.

owis.original: समशा पुरतां सुखी होती । श्रोते अवघे आनंदती । अवघे क्षणक्षणा वंदिती । गोसावियांसी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्यांची जी समस्या आहे ती जर व्यवस्थितपणें सोडविली तर सर्वांना आनंद होतो. आणि सर्व श्रोते वक्त्याला वंदन करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When every thing is seen with equal vision then, you will feel satisfaction and happiness. Due to such a good listener, every thing will be filled with joy and every moment the mind will worship that one who has renounced the world (ie. knowledge does not see a world of `many' forms).

owis.original: समशा पुरतां वंदिती । समशा न पुरतां निंदिती । गोसांवी चिणचिण करिती । कोण्या हिशेबें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समस्या सोडविली तर श्रोते वंदन करतात. समस्या सोडविली नाहीं तर श्रोते निंदा करतात. मग वक्त्यानें उगीच चिडचिड करण्याचें कारण नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When you are full of this vision of the `all', that is worship. And when you are not full of this vision of the `all' then, there is complaining and criticising. But why should that one who has renounced the world give any regard to these things and allow Himself to get aroused into body consciousness (maharaj- you care for what the people will say...don't care for anything).

owis.original: शुध सोनें पाहोन घ्यावें । कसीं लाउनी तावावें । श्रवणमननें जाणावें । प्रत्ययासी ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सोनें शुद्ध पाहून घ्यावें. तें कसाला लावावें, तापवून परीक्षावें. त्याचप्रमाणें श्रवण व मनन या साधनांनी प्रत्ययाची परीक्षा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: This pure gold of the `all' experience should be understood and accepted. Why should it be tested again (ie. knowledge is your nature, it requires no effort; what need is there to know it further? If you try to know it further then, you only divide this knowledge into `many' different forms. If you know it is gold then, there is no need to know the different pieces of jewellery)? Therefore due to shravan and manana, that nirgun should be known.

owis.original: वैद्याची प्रचित येना । वेथा परती होयेना । आणी रागेजावें जना । कोण्या हिशेबें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्याला त्याच्या रोगावर वैद्याच्या औषधाचा गुण आला नाहीं, तर इतर लोकांवर त्याचा राग काढायचा हा कोठचा न्याय?
owis.englishMeaning: If the *doctor does not have this `experience' then, suffering will surely remain. Then he will have to endure the anger of the people. But why will the one with this `experience' care for this world? *(One who gives superficial relief. But he cannot take you beyond body consciousness nor prevent you from dying)

owis.original: खोटें कोठेंचि चालेना । खोटें कोणास मानेना । याकारणें अनुमाना । खरें आणावें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें खोटें असतें तें कुठेंच चालत नाहीं. तें कुणालाच आवडत नाहीं. या कारणानें जें खरें आहे त्याचेंच प्रतिपादन करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Tell me, in this world, where is the false not? And who is there who has no respect for this false? Therefore by means of this `speech', all conjecture and guesswork should be brought to the Truth. (In this false worldly existence, everyone is giving value and having respect for the false only)5

owis.original: लिहिणें न येतां व्यापार केला। कांहीं येक दिवस चालिला । पुसता सुरनीस भेटला । तेव्हां खोटें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका माणासाला लिहीतां येत नव्हतें त्यानें व्यापार केला. तो कांहीं दिवस चालला. पुढें त्याला हिशेब तपासणीस भेटला, त्यानें हिशेब तपासले. तेव्हां व्यापार खोटा आहे असें लक्षांत आलें.
owis.englishMeaning: If you do not learn how to `write' properly then, that One will function in this worldly business as a jiva for some *days only. But if you ask for a meeting with a proper `examiner' then, he will prove this whole world is false (if you seek out the Truth through the scriptures and the teachings of the Saint then, your mind will become a proper examiner). *(The mind only thinks of yesterdays and tomorrows and without understanding this moment, life slips away)

owis.original: सर्व आवघें हिशेबीं ठावें । प्रत्यय साक्षीनें बोलावें । मग सुरनीसें काये करावें । सांगाना कां ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हिशेबावरुन व्यापाराबद्दल सर्व कांहीं लक्षांत येते. त्याचप्रमाणें वक्त्यानें बोलतांना आपल्या अनुभवाच्या पुराव्यानें बोलावें. हिशेब जर बरोबर ठेवलें असतील तर हिशेब तपासणीस काय करुं शकणार? सांगा कीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If the `many' thoughts can have regard for this `all' and if that nirgun Self can be the witness and `speak' then, why can that proper `examiner' not have regard for thoughtlessness (maharaj- where there is a will, there is a way)? (Within our mind there is complete understanding and there is complete misunderstanding also; everything is with our mind)

owis.original: स्वये आपणचि गुंते । समजावीस कैसी होते । नेणतां कोणीयेक ते । आपदों लागती ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो स्वतःच घोटाळ्यांत अडकतो तो दुसर्‍याला समजावून देणें कठीण असते. त्याच्या नादी लागणारे अडाणी लोक अडचणींत सापडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When you entangle yourself then, how can there be any understanding? If you remain ignorant and don't practice this knowing (ie. forget everything), then that One within everyone gets distressed.

owis.original: बळेंविण युद्धास गेला । तो सर्वस्वें नागवला । शब्द ठेवावा कोणाला । कोण कैसा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या माणसाजवळ बळ नाहीं. तो लढायला गेला, तर तो सर्वस्वीं नागवला जातो. अशा प्रसंगामध्यें कोणी कोणाला दोष द्यायचा.
owis.englishMeaning: It is the same as one who goes to war without unflinching belief and determination. He will surely be defeated and his own property will be stolen away. Then who is there to blame other than himself?

owis.original: जें प्रचीतीस आलें खरें । तेंचि घ्यावें अत्यादरें । अनुभवेंविण जें उतरें । तें फलकटें जाणावीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें खरें म्हणून आपल्या प्रचितीला येतें, त्याचे मोठ्या आदरानें आपण ग्रहण करावें. अनुभवाशिवाय बोललेली किंवा लिहिलेली वचनें फुसकी समजावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: If that Truth comes to mula maya then, that should be gratefully accepted. But if mula maya replies without this `experience' then, you should know that you have made that Reality into an empty shell (maharaj- you do not cherish the joy of this un- derstanding). (maharaj- if you can understand once then, why can you not understand moment to moment)

owis.original: सिकऊं जाता राग चढे । परंतु पुढें आदळ घडे । खोटा निश्र्चय तात्काळ उडे । लोकामधें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी वचनें बोलणार्‍याला कोणी शिकवूं लागलें तर त्यास राग येतो. परंतु पुढें त्याला अद्दल घडते. खोट्या गोष्टी लोकांसमोर खर्‍या म्हणून कितीही निश्र्चयानें मांडल्या तरी ते लगेच खोट्या ठरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If anger or some other sentiment arises while you are teaching your mind and then these will bring trouble and exhaustion afterwards. For then upon that time of understanding, the false thoughts within this `all' world will surely spring up.

owis.original: खरें सांडुनी खोटे घेणें । भकाधेस काये उणें । त्रिभुवनीं नारायणे । न्याय केला ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जर एखादा माणूस खरें सोडून मुद्दम खोटें घेऊं लागला, तर निंदा लगेचच होते. तिन्ही लोकांमध्यें देवानें हा न्याय करुन ठेवला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: And if the Truth is left aside and the false is accepted then, there will be no end to this aimless wandering. Therefore understand that within these three worlds that you wander, narayana has established the Truth.

owis.original: तो न्याय सांडितां सेवटीं । अवघें जगचि लागे पाठीं । जनीं भांडभांडों हिंपुटीं । किती व्हावें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो न्याय जर माणसानें सोदला तर सगळे जग त्याच्या पाठीस लागतें. लोकांशी भांडता भांडता तो अगदी बेजार होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But if you leave aside that Truth then, in the end, you will only have the support of the gross world of `many' thoughts. Therefore how long should one keep quarrelling with this world and remain miserable?

owis.original: अन्यायें बहुतांस पुरवलें । हें देखिलें ना ऐकिलें । वेडें उगेंचि भरीं भरलें । असत्याचे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अन्यायानें पुष्कळ लोकांना आधार दिला असें आजपर्यंत कोणी ऐकलें नाहीं. किंवा पाहिलें नाही. पण वेडी माणसें उगीच खोट्या किंवा असत्याच्या भरीस पडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Can this `all' pervade throughout when you take yourself to be a body? That has never been seen or heard of. Due to Its madness for worldly objects, that still and silent Self, has gone running headlong and obstinately after the untrue.

owis.original: असत्य म्हणिजे तेंचि पाप । सत्य जाणावें स्वरुप । दोहींमधें साक्षप । कोणाचा करावा ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सत्य हेंच स्वस्वरुप आहे असें समजावें. तर असत्य हेंच पाप होय.या दोन्हीमध्यें सत्याचाच उद्योग करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The untrue means that Reality has become a body and the Truth means that swarup is known. The one you choose is up to you.

owis.original: मायेमधें बोलणें चालणें साचें । माया नस्तां बोलणें कैंचें । याकारणें निशब्दाचें । मूळ शोधावे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाचें सारें बोलणें चालणें मायेच्या क्षेत्रामध्यें खरें असते. जेथे माया नाहीं तेथें बोलण्यास स्थान नसतें. म्हणून आपण निःशब्दाचे मूळ शोधावें.
owis.englishMeaning: In maya this `speech' (ie. existence) and `moving' form (ie. knowledge) are regarded as real. But if maya is not, then how can there be this `speech'? Still with this `speech' (ie. `word'), this root of the wordless should be searched out.

owis.original: वाच्यांश जाणोनी सांडावा । लक्ष्यांश विवरोन घ्यावा । याकारणें निशब्द मुळाचा गोवा । आढळेना ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्दाचा अर्थ समजून घ्यावा. व शब्द मागें टाकावा. असें केल्यानें निःशब्द मूळ जें स्वरुप त्याबद्दल कांहींच घोटाळा उरत नाहीं. स्वरुपची अगदी स्पष्ट कल्पना येते.
owis.englishMeaning: The `word' meaning should be understood and then left aside and the implied meaning should be investigated and accepted. Then by means of this `speech', there is that wordless Self that can never fall into this entanglement that began at the root.

owis.original: अष्टधा प्रकृती पूर्वपक्ष । सांडून अलक्षीं लावावें लक्ष । मननसीळ परम दक्ष । तोचि जाणे ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अष्टधा प्रकृती किंवा दृश्य विश्र्व हें मिथ्या असल्यानें तो पूर्वपक्ष होय. तो पूर्वपक्ष सोडावा. नंतर अलक्ष जें स्वरुप किंवा परब्रह्म त्याच्या ठिकाणीं लक्ष लावावें. जो अतिशय दक्ष व मननशील आहे, त्याला हें कसें करावें हें समजते.
