owis.englishMeaning: The eightfold prakruti is the original hypothesis. Leaving this aside, concentrate on that which `cannot be concentrated on'. When that purush is extremely alert and is the possessor of manana, then only can It know that thoughtless swarup.

owis.original: नाना भूस आणि कण । येकचि म्हणणें अप्रमाण । रस चोवडिया कोण । शाहाणा सेवी ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूस व कण हीं दोन्ही एकच आहेत असें म्हनणें अयोग्य आहे. उसाचा रस सोडून शहाणा माणूस चोयट्या चोखीत बसणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But when there are only the `many' husks and grains then, that One gets called false (those with no vivek say, "I cannot see any God; there is no such thing"). But why would the wise leave aside the juice and take the dry chaff?

owis.original: पिंडीं नित्यानित्य विवेक । ब्रह्मांडीं सारासार अनेक । सकळ शोधूनियां येक । सार घ्यावें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडासाठीं आत्मानात्मविवेक अथवा नित्यानित्यविवेक करावा. ब्रह्मांडासाठीं सारासारविवेक करावा. अशा रीतीनें सगळ्याचा शोध घेऊन जें सार असेल तें ग्रहण करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the numerous different forms then, in the pinda there should be the vivek between the *indestructible and destructible. And afterwards in the brahmanda, that thoughtless essence should be understood by rejecting the non-essence. There- fore search out this `all' and then take only that One essence (when you understand the antar-atma then, this pinda merges in the brahmanda and there is the vision of knowledge. Now that essence within this should be searched out). *(ie. the `many' different forms are destructible and this antar-atma remains knowing this `all')

owis.original: मायेकरितां कोणीयेक । अन्वय आणी वीतरेक । ते माया नस्तां विवेक । कैसा करावा ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माया आहे तोपर्यंत अन्वय आणि व्यतिरेक करावा लागतो. ' अ  ' असला तर ' ब ' असतो. हा अन्वय. तर  ' अ ' असला तर ' ब ' नसतो. हा व्यतिरेक होय. पण जेथें माया नाहींशी होते तेथें अन्वय व्यतिरेक उरतच नाहीं. तेथें तर्काचे प्रयोजन संपतें.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of maya, that One within everyone (and beyond maya) can use the two methods of anvaya/connectedness and vyatireka/non-connectedness to prove what is True and what is false. And when maya is proved to be non-existent then, why should that Reality make such vivek anymore? (One cannot break these bonds of maya without proper thinking: krishna- your mind is your bondage and the mind is your liberation)

owis.original: तत्वें तत्व सर्व शोधावें । माहांवाकीं प्रवेशावें । आत्मनिवेदनें पावावें । समाधान ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका तत्वानें दुसरें अशा रीतीनें सर्व तत्वांचा शोध घ्यावा. नंतर महावाक्यांच्या अर्थाशीं तदाकार होऊन जावें. आणि संपूर्ण आत्मनिवेदन करुन समाधान पावावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Each great element should be dissolved into the previous element (ie. the dissolution of objectification) and this `all' should be searched out and within this `great speech' one should enter. Then by surrender of yourself to that atma there is the attainment of complete satisfaction/samadhan (pure knowledge). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Uttampurusha Nirupan (A Discourse on the Best Purush)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: नाना वस्त्रें नाना भूषणें । येणेम शरीर श्रृंघारणें । विवेकें विचारें राजकारणें । अंतर श्रृंघारिजे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारची वस्त्रें आणि भूषणें यांनीं शरीर शोभिवंत केलें जातें. विवेक, विचार आणि राजकारण यांनीं अंतर्याम शोभिवंत केलें जातें.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' fine clothes and the `many' ornaments that adorn this gross body and there is thoughtlessness, the adornment of this `all' body. Through vivek, your inner space should be decorated first with *rajakarana and then with thoughtlessness. *(To know who is the King and doer)

owis.original: शरीर सुंदर सतेज । वस्त्रें भूषणें केलें सज्ज । अंतरीं नस्तां च्यातुर्यबीज । कदापि शोभा न पवे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा, एखाद्याचें शरीर मोठें सुंदर आणि सतेज आहे. शिवाय चांगल्या वस्त्रांनी व भूषणांनीं तें शृंगारलें तरीपण अंतर्यामी चतुरपणा नसेल तर तें कांहीं शोभत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This `all' body is beautiful and majestic but it has been covered over with clothes and ornaments (ie. body consciousness). If there is not this seed of wisdom in your inner space then, there can never be any splendour or glory.

owis.original: तुंड हेंकाड कठोरवचनी । अखंड तोले साभिमानी । न्याय नेति अंतःकर्णी । घेणार नाहीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तोंडाळ, हेकट स्वभावाचा आणि कठोर शब्द बोलणारा माणूस निरंतर अभिमानाच्या मदानें जणुं काय डोलत असतो. तो आपल्या मनांत न्याय नीतिचा विचार आणीत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that unbroken Self within this great pride of `I am' is under the influence of this ugly and crude form ("I am a body") and this soft divine `speech' has become harsh and cruel. Then in your antah-karana there is no acceptance of justice or equanimity.

owis.original: तर्‍हे सीघ्रकोपी सदा । कदापि न धरी मर्यादा । राजकारण संवादा । मिळोंचि नेणे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो मोठा तर्‍हेवाईक असून शीघ्रकोपी असतो. कधीही कोणाची मर्यादा ठेवित नाहीं. राजकारणामध्यें जुळवून घ्यायला तो कधीं तयार होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then one's manner is always irritable and one does not know how to be restrained. Then that purush does not know nor can He accept this silent dialogue of rajakarana (`He is doing everything').

owis.original: ऐसे लौंद बेइमानी । कदापि सत्य नाहीं वचनीं । पापी अस्मार जनीं । राक्षेस जाणावे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असा दुष्ट माणूस बेईमानी किंवा बेभरवशाचा असतो. त्याच्या बोलण्यांत कधीही खरेंपणा नसतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then one is dirty and faithless and there can never be that Truth that is within this divine `speech'. Then one has the sin of body consciousness and a troublesome mind that is no better than a demon (ie. in its ignorance it destroys everything).

owis.original: समयासारिखा समयो येना । नेम सहसा चालेना । नेम धरितां राजकारणा । अंतर पडे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेळ सदैव सारखी नसतें. यासाठी एकच नियम सतत चालूं शकत नाहीं. नियम चालवण्याचा आग्रह धरला तर राजकारणामधें अडचणी येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In this world when proper practice is not maintained then, you will say, "The time that has been, can never come again" and then one occasion is never like another (but every moment should be like the previous; for you are always there. That `experience' should be gained. Mind breaks this endless moment apart and imagines `many' different occasions and past and future). But if the proper practice of rajakarana is firmly main- tained then, even this inner space will cease to be (ie. even this `now' is an appearance on that timeless Reality).

owis.original: अति सर्वत्र वर्जावें । प्रसंग पाहोन चालावें । हटनिग्रहीं न पडावें । विवेकी पुरुषें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणत्याहि गोष्टीमधें अति वर्ज करावें. जसा प्रसंग असेल तसें वागावें. विचारवंत माणसानें हट्टीपणानें उगाच आग्रह धरुन बसूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore there should be keen alertness everywhere so that this `all' connection is understood and maintained. That viveki purush should never be obstinate and try to hold on to this knowledge (therefore let whatever comes, come. Do not try to hold onto that which has already gone; for that is mind's work).

owis.original: बहुतचि करितां हट । तेथें येऊन पडिले तट । कोणीयेकाचा सेवट । जाला पाहिजे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या गोष्टीचा फार आग्रह धरला तर आपसांत फूट पडतें. त्यामुळें दोन किंवा अधिक पक्ष निर्माण होतात. अशा परिस्थितींत कोणत्या तरी एका पक्षाचा शेवट व्हावा लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And if this `all' becomes obstinate, that atma `there' falls into divisions and sepa- rations. Therefore there should be the unwavering understanding that, `I am the One within everyone' (ie. total detachment; `I cannot be anything which I see or perceive').

owis.original: बरें ईश्र्वर आहे साभिमानी । विशेष तुळजाभोवानी । परंतु विचार पाहोनी । कार्ये करणें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण एक गोष्ट चांगली आहे, कीं, ईश्र्वराला आपला अभिमान आहे. त्यानें आपल्याला आपलें म्हटलें आहे. विशेषतः तुळजाभवानीची आपल्यावर कृपा आहे. हे जरी खरें आहे तरी नेहमी विचार करुनच कोणतेंहीं कार्य करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this pure sattwa guna, that thoughtless ishwara within this great pride `I am' will be realized. But as long as this pure sattwa of goddess maya (`I am' is His power of creation) remains, then His thoughtlessness is made to perform this sagun action (ishwara is, in truth, completely detached but He has taken this witnessing upon Himself and the triad of Knower, known and knowing has arisen).

owis.original: अखंडचि सावधाना । बहुत काये करावी सूचना । परंतु कांहीं येक अनुमाना । आणिलें पाहिजे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो सतत सावधपणें वागतो, त्याला आणखी वेगळी सूचना करण्याची गरज नाहीं. पण कांहीं गोष्टी त्यानें ध्यानांत ठेवून वागणें जरुर आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But if that unbroken swarup is completely alert then, how can this `all' be known? (then there is no-otherness and no Knower nor known remains) However to understand that, all your conjecture has to be given away to that One who is within this `thing'.

owis.original: समर्थापासीं बहुत जन । राहिला पाहिजे साभिमान । निश्र्चळ करुनियां मन । लोक असती ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: थोर व सामर्थ्यसंपन्न पुरुषाजवळ अनेक माणसें असतात. अशा माणसांचा आपण अभिमान धरला पाहिजे. असें पाहून तीं माणसें सुद्धा मग एकनिष्ठेनें वागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When the people (individual mind) and this `all' (universal mind) are in the charge of that nirgun purush then, this great pride ceases and the mind resting in this world beyond becomes still (ie. then there is no-mind, for I do not exist).

owis.original: म्लेच दुर्जन उदंड । बहुतां दिसाचें माजलें बंड । याकारणें अखंड । सावधान असावें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार दिवसांपासून दुर्जन म्लेंछांचे बंड माजलें आहे. या कारणानें आपण सतत सावघानपणानें राहावें. केव्हां धोका होईल याचा नेम नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But that paramatma has appeared as this powerful foreigner `far from the atma' (ie. "I am a body" pride/ego) and for some days he has swollen with arrogance and stolen the throne (of the King).7 Therefore by means of this `speech', that unbroken Self should be made very alert.

owis.original: सकळकर्ता तो ईश्र्वरु । तेणें केला अंगिकारु । तया पुरुषाचा विचारु । विरुळा जाणे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ईश्र्वर खरा सर्व कर्ता आहे. तो ज्याचा अंगीकार करतो. त्याच्यावर कृपा करतो. अशा पुरुषाचे जीवन एखाद्यालाच कळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When you understand that the `doer' of this `all' is ishwara then, an *acceptor has been created (when the "I am doing" concept has been dropped then, you accept `He is the doer and enjoyer' and there is witnessing. This is proper rajakarana). But still the thoughtlessness of that purush is not; and that is known to only a few (ie. the sadguru understands that this knowledge/`all' is zero). *(maharaj- an acceptor is required)

owis.original: न्याय नीति विवेक विचार । नाना प्रसंग प्रकार । परीक्षिणें परांतर । देणें ईश्र्वराचें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: न्याय, नीति, विवेक,विचार, अनेक प्रकारच्या प्रसंगांना तोंड देणे, दुसर्‍याच्या अंतःकरणाची बरोबर परीक्षा होणें या गोष्टी ज्या पुरुषाच्या ठिकाणीं आधळतात. त्याच्यावर ईश्र्वराची कृपा झालेली असते.
owis.englishMeaning: The gifts that come from being ishwara (ie. the Witness) are justice and equanimity, vivek and thoughtlessness. When the ways of the `many' are this `all' connection and when this `all' is carefully examined then, there is That which is beyond this inner space; parabrahman.

owis.original: माहायेत्न सावधपणें । समईं धारिष्ट धरणें । अद्भुतचि कार्य करणें । देणें ईश्र्वराचें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खबरदारीनें केलेला अति मोठा प्रयत्न, कठीण प्रसंगामध्यें धरलेला मोठा धीर आणि अद्भुत कार्य घडवून आणणें, हीं ईश्र्वर कृपेची लक्षणें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Alertness and great effort are gifts that come from being the Witness. Then in this difficult time (of being a body), there is fortitude and resolve and the wondrous action of this `all' is acquired.

owis.original: येश कीर्ति प्रताप महिमा । उत्तम गुणासी नाहीं सीमा । नाहीं दुसरी उपमा । देणें ईश्र्वराचें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या यश, कीर्ति, प्रताप, महिमाआणि उत्तम गुणांना सीमाच उरत नाहीं, ज्यास दुसर्‍याची उपमाच देता येत नाहीं, त्याच्यावर ईश्र्वराची कृपा आहे असें समजावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Success, fame (ie. pervasiveness), authority and the greatness of brahman are gifts that come from being the Witness. Then even this best guna, that has no limits, cannot be compared to that thoughtless Self.

owis.original: देव ब्राह्मण आचार विचार । कितेक जनासी आधार । सदा घडे परोपकार । देणें ईश्र्वराचें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो पुरुष देव व ब्राह्मण यांना मानतो, आचार व विचार सांभाळतो, पुष्कळ लोकांना आधार देतो, आणि ज्याच्या हातून सतत परोपकार घडतो, तो माणूस ईश्र्वरीकृपेला पात्र झालेला असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The gift that comes from being the Witness is that you become yourself God and a brahmin (ie. Knower of brahman). Then your proper conduct (ie. knowing) becomes the thoughtlessness of brahman. Then there is that One who supports the people and uplifts this `all' (then that One uses knowledge to stay in the world).

owis.original: येहलोक परलोक पाहाणें । अखंड सावधपणें राहाणें । बहुत जनाचें साहाणें । देणें ईश्र्वराचें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रपंच व परमार्थ दोन्हीकडे ज्याचे योग्य लक्ष असते, जोसतत सावधानपणें राहतो, जो पुष्कळांचें पुष्कळ सोसतो, तो पुरुष ईश्र्वरी कृपेला पात्र झालेला असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The gift that comes from being the Witness is that you understand this world while alertly staying in this world beyond. This `all' knows how to bear all the troubles of this mundane existence (maharaj- when you don't care for yourself then, the Self takes care)

owis.original: देवाचा कैपक्ष घेणें । ब्राह्मणाची चिंता वाहाणें । बहु जनासी पाळणें । देणें ईश्र्वराचें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो देवाचा कैवार घेतो, ब्राह्माणांची काळजी घेतो, पुष्कळ लोकांचा सांभाळ करतो त्याच्यावर ईश्र्वराची कृपा झालेली असते.
owis.englishMeaning: When you take the side of God and cherish the thinking of the brahmin (ie. Knower of brahman), it is a gift that comes from being the Witness. Then you are the support and the protector of the `many' people. (When maharaj was asked why he took all this trouble to travel and teach in so many countries at his age, He said, "Because I see myself in trouble")

owis.original: धर्मस्थापनेचे नर । ते ईश्र्वराचे अवतार । जाले आहेत पुढें होणार । देणें ईश्र्वराचें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जे पुरुष धर्म स्थापन करतात, ते ईश्र्वराचा अवतार असतात. असे पुरुष पूर्वी झाले, आज आहेत व पुढेंही होतील. असें पुरुष होणें ही ईश्र्वराची कृपाच होय.
owis.englishMeaning: The gift that comes from being the Witness is that, man becomes this place of *dharma. And afterwards when this `all' of the Witness is relinquished then, there is that Reality which has always been and will always be. *(Our inherent nature, to be and to know)

owis.original: उत्तम गुणाचा ग्राहिक । तर्क तीक्षण विवेक । धर्मवासना पुण्यश्रलोक । देणें ईश्र्वराचें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो पुरुष उत्तम गुणांचा चाहता आहे, ज्याच्यापाशीं तीव्र बुद्धी व विवेकशक्ती आहे, ज्याला केवळ शुभवासनाच आहेत, असा पुरुष ईश्र्वरी कृपेचेच फळ होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When you long to perform your dharma and have this most praiseworthy connection to knowledge then, it is a gift that comes from being the Witness. But first there must be proper thinking, earnestness and vivek, for only then will you be capable of understanding this pure sattwa guna.

owis.original: सकळ गुणांमधें सार । तजविजा विवेक विचार । जेणें पाविजे पैलपार । अरत्रपरत्रींचा ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या विवेकविचारानें आणि योजनेनें प्रपंच आणि परमार्थ दोन्ही नीटपणें पार पडतात, तो विचार व ती योजना सर्व गुणांचे सार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless essence is within this `all' guna (pure sattwa guna). And if one earnestly makes this vivek between the indestructible and destructible then, afterwards there can be thoughtlessness. Understand that, it is only through mula maya that the other shore, beyond this gross world and even this world of the `all', can be reached. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Jana Swabhav Nirupan (A Discourse on People's Nature)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: जनाचा लालची स्वभाव । आरंभींच म्हणती देव । म्हणिजे मला कांहीं देव । ॥ ऐसी वासना ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सामान्य जनांचा स्वभाव मुळांत स्वार्थी व लोभी असतो. ते जेव्हां देव हा शब्द उच्चारतात, तेव्हां आधींच मला कांहींतरी द्यावे. अशी वासना त्यांच्या मनांत असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When this ever-present `all' becomes the greed of a man then, the first thing that is said is, dev.8 This means, "Give me something." Then this vasana/desire that simply wanted to be, now has become so `many' desires.

owis.original: कांहींच भक्ति केली नस्तां । आणी इच्छिती प्रसन्नता । जैसें कांहींच सेवा न करितां । स्वामीस मागती ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ते देवाची भक्ती मुळींच करीत नाहींत आणि देवानें प्रसन्न व्हावें अशी अपेक्षा बाळगतात. एखादा नोकर कांहीं काम न करतां मालकाजवळ पगार मागतो तसा हा प्रकार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Though that mind has no devotion to God still, it wants that God should be pleased with it and so give it all that it desires! Similarly, though we have no devotion to this `thing', yet we go begging to swami, "Give us this `thing'." (This `thing' is not something the Master can place in your hand or give you by touching your head. He can only point it out through His instructions. But if you do not follow these, then?)

owis.original: कष्टेंविण फळ नाहीं । कष्टेंविण राज्य नाहीं । केल्याविण होत नाहीं । साध्य जनीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या जगांत कष्टावांचून फळ मिळत नाहीं. कष्टावांचून राज्य मिळत नाहीं. कष्ट केल्यावांचून जगांत कोणतीहि गोष्ट साध्य होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as there can be no gain without painstaking effort, so too, there cannot be this kingdom without painstaking effort. Just as in this world nothing can be achieved without actually doing it, so too, this kingdom cannot be gained without actually going there.

owis.original: आळसें काम नासतें । हें तो प्रत्ययास येतें । कष्टाकडे चुकावितें । हीन जन ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आळशीपणानें कार्याचा नाश होतो. असा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव येतो. असें असूनही हीन प्रतीचे लोक कष्ट करण्यांत चुकारपणा करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: *Laziness spoils our need to reach that thoughtless paramatma. When the people keep the company of fruitless wearisome toil then, that Self is made to forget Its own Self. *(Here laziness means, doing many worldly actions, being constantly busy, but not doing that which you should do ie. not making vivek)

owis.original: आधीं कष्टाचें दुःख सोसिती । ते पुढें सुखाचें फळ भोगिती । आधीं आळसें सुखावती । त्यासी पुढें दुःख ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जे लोक आधी कष्टाचे दुःख सोसतात तेंच लोक पुढें सुखाचें फळ भोगतात. जे लोक आधी आळसानें सुखावतात तें लोक पुढें दुःख भोगतात.
owis.englishMeaning: However, if at first that One endures the hardship of suffering then, afterwards that One will enjoy the fruit of happiness. And if at first, that One enjoys laziness then, afterwards that One will suffer terribly.

owis.original: येहलोक अथवा परलोक । दोहिमकडे सरिखाचि विवेक । दीर्घ सूचनेचें कौतुक । कळलें पाहिजे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रपंच असो कीं परमार्थ असो, दोन्हीकडे विवेक सारखाच असतो. पुढची योजना आखून वागण्याचे महत्व कळलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: Both this gross world and the world beyond become the same when there is vivek. Therefore this `wonder' of continuous knowing should be understood.

owis.original: मेळविती तितुकें भक्षिती । ते कठीण काळीं मरोन जाती । दीर्घ सूचनेनें वर्तती । तेंचि भले ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण जेवढें मिळवलें त्यापैकीं कांहीं शिल्लक न ठेवतां सगळें खाऊन फस्त केलें तर पुढें कठीण काळ आल्यावर जगणें मुश्किल होते. म्हणून पुढची योजना आखून जें वागतात ते शाहाणें ठरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One destroys that thoughtlessness which should be acquired then, that brahman becomes maya and when in this time of the `all', it will have to die (this `all' is the beginning of time and it is not the eternal. Death awaits it. For before death can come to this body, this knowledge will go off, and everything will be shallowed up in ignorance). But if one stays by this continual knowing then, one becomes that Reality.

owis.original: येहलोकींचा संचितार्थ । परलोकींचा परमार्थ । संचितेविण वेर्थ । जीत मेलें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या जगांत सुखानें जगण्यास सांठविलेला पैसा उपयोगी पडतो. तर परलोकांत समाधानी परमार्थ उपयोगी पडतो. ज्याच्यापाशी सांठविलेला पैसा नसतो तो जिवंत असून मृतवत होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the acquisition of the wealth in this gross world and there is the acquisition of paramarth/Supreme wealth, in this world beyond.9 And without that Supreme wealth, there is just a useless living corpse.

owis.original: येकदा मेल्यानें सुटेना । पुन्हा जन्मोजन्मीं यातना । आपणास मारी वांचविना । तो आत्महत्यारा ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकदा मरुन माणूस सुटत नाहीं. त्याला पुनः पुनः जन्म येतात व यातना भोगाव्या लागतात. जो स्वतःला न वांचवतां स्वतःचाच घात करतो, तो आत्महत्यारा होय.
owis.englishMeaning: By dying once there is no release from bondage and there will birth after birth and suffering, again and again. If that atma does not save Itself from death then, It has become a `killer of Its own Self'.

owis.original: प्रतिजन्मीं आत्मघात । कोणें करावें गणीत । याकारणें जन्ममृत्य । केवी चुके ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें प्रत्येक जन्मांत घात चालतो. असें किती जन्म होतांत याचे गणित करतां येत नाहीं. अशा रीतीनें जीवन जगून जन्ममृत्यु चुकत नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: For repeated births we have committed such suicides. Who can count the number of times? But, by means of this `speech', the cycle of birth and death can be avoided.

owis.original: देव सकळ कांहीं करितो । ऐसें प्राणिमात्र बोलतो । त्याचे भेटीचा लाभ तो । अकस्मात जाला ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव सर्व कांहीं करतो ासें सगळीं माणसें म्हणतात. भगवंताची भेट मात्र अकस्मात होते.
owis.englishMeaning: God is the `doer' and this `all thing' is His action and within the whole of the prana, His `speech' is always there.10 If you learn to listen to this, then you will *suddenly gain a meeting with Him. *(The moment you stop trying to meet Him, He is there)

owis.original: विवेकाचा लाभ घडे । जेणें परमात्मा ठाईं पडे । विवेक पाहातां सांपडे । विवेकी जनीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्याजवळ खरा आत्मानात्मविवेक असतो, त्याला परमात्मा सांपडतो. आणि विवेकी पुरुषापाशी विेवेकाचा लाभ होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The accomplishment of vivek is when this mula maya/`speech', discovers that thou- ghtless paramatma. When you are making this this `speech', then you are the viveki within the people (by this `speech' you are lifted out of this world and enter that world beyond. But still further vivek is required).

owis.original: देव पाहातां आहे येक । परंतु करितो अनेक । त्या अनेकास येक । म्हणों नये कीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खरें पाहिलें तर देव एकच आहे. सामान्य माणूस अनेक देव मानतो. त्या अनेक देवांना एक देव म्हणतां येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then you will understand that God is One and He created the numerous different shapes. However that One should not be called the numerous different shapes.

owis.original: देवाचें कर्तुत्व आणि देव । कळला पाहिजे अभिप्राव । कळल्याविण कितेक जीव । उगेच बोलती ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवांचे मूळ स्वरुप व देवांचें कर्तेपण हीं दोन खरी कशीं आहेत हेम बरोबर समजून घ्यावें. तें न कळतांच पुष्कळ लोक त्याबद्दल बोलतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the work of God and there is God. The significance of this should be understood. Without understanding God, that One within the `many' will appear as a jiva or that still and silent Self will be made to `speak'.

owis.original: उगेच बोलती मूर्खपणें । शाहाणपण वाढायाकारणें । त्रुप्तिलागीं उपाव करणें । ऐसें जालें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला शहाणपणा दाखवण्यासाठीं काहीं लोक उगीच मूर्खपणानें देवाबद्दल व त्याच्या कर्तेपणाबद्दल बोलतात.एखाद्या माणसाला भूक लागलीं असतां भुकेची तृप्ती होण्यासाठीं भोजन करणें हा सरळ उपाय आहे. तो न करतां इतर उपाय करीत बसण्यासारखें हें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But even this `speech' is a foolish thing and yet it boasts about how wise it is. Really it is like that One who has real contentment, taking a remedy to get rid of it.

owis.original: जेहीं उदंड कष्ट केले । ते भाग्य भोगून ठेले । येर ते बोलताचि राहिले । करंटे जन ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें लोक मनस्वी कष्ट करतात तेच भाग्य भोगित राहातात. बाकीचे भाग्यहीन लोक नुसती बडबड करीत जगतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If this mula maya makes great effort then, it will enjoy good fortune. But when that stops `speaking' then, it is a misfortunate jiva in the people.

owis.original: करंट्याचें करंट लक्षण । समजोन जाती विचक्षण । भल्याचें उत्तम लक्षण । करंट्यास कळेना ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें शहाणें असतात तें करंट्याचे करंतपण समजून जातात. पण चांगल्याचे चांगुलपणाचें लक्षण मात्र करंट्यास समजत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The wise and clear-sighted understand the misfortunate and the attentions of the misfortunate. But that attention of the wise cannot be known by the misfortunate.

owis.original: त्याची पैसावली कुबुद्धी । तेथें कैंची असेल शुद्धी । कुबुद्धी तेचि सुदुद्धी । ऐसी वाटे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो करंटा असतो त्याच्या अंगी कुबुद्धीचे प्राबल्य असतें. त्याच्या ठिकाणी जणूं शुद्धीच नसतें. कुबुद्धीलाच तो सुबुद्धी समजतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If that impure buddhi of the jiva is allowed to grow then, how can there be the purity of `there'? Yet even so, this impure buddhi still feels that it has a pure buddhi only.

owis.original: मनुष्य शुद्धीस सांडावें । त्याचें काये खरें मानावें । जेथें विचाराच्या नांवें । सुन्याकार ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो माणूस नीट शुद्धीमध्यें नाहीं, त्याचे कोणतेही बोलणें खरें मानता येत नाही. त्याच्या ठिकाणी विचाराच्या नावांनें शून्य असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If a man should leave aside that pure buddhi, then how can he ever contemplate upon the Truth? `Here' in maya and on account of this "Mr. so and so", that thoughtless Truth has been drowned.

owis.original: विचारें येहलोक परलोक । विचारें होतसे सार्थक । विचारें नित्यानित्य विवेक । पाहिला पाहिजे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विचारानें इहलोक व परलोक साधतो. विचारानें सार्थक होतें. विचारानें नित्यानित्यविवेक पाहिला पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of thoughtlessness, there is this world and the world beyond. On account of thoughtlessness, there is the fulfilment of life (ie. the thoughtless One is realized). On account of thoughtlessness there is this vivek between the indestructible and destructible and this should be understood. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Antardev Nirupan (A Discourse on the God Within)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ब्रह्म निराकार निश्र्चळ । आत्म्यास विकार चंचळ । तयास म्हणती सकळ । देव ऐसें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म निराकार व निश्चळ आहे. आत्मा चंचळ असून त्यास विकार आहे. त्याला सगळे लोक देव म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: brahman is formless and still. And when there is a disturbance or movement then, that brahman is called the atma (ie. antar-atma). And then they say that this `all' and God is the same as that Reality. (brahman is formless and still; and when there is this `I am' feeling then He assumes the roles of the hidden purush and His prakruti and there is the feeling, `I am everywhere'. And those who don't understand, they say, this pair is Reality)

owis.original: देवाचा ठावचि लागेना । येक देव नेमस्त कळेना । बहुत देवीं अनुमानेना । येक देव ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वस्तुस्थिति अशी आहे कीं, देवाचा पत्ता लागत नाहीं. एक देव कोणता हें निश्चयपूर्वक कळत नाहीं.पुष्कळ देव पाहिलें कीं, यापैकीं खरा एक देव कोणता त्याची कल्पना करतां येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But that place of God cannot be met; for the limited cannot understand that One God. If even this `all' within that God cannot be found from surmise then, how can that One God ever be found?

owis.original: म्हणोनी विचार असावा । विचारें देव शोधावा । बहुत देवांचा गोवा । पडोंचि नये ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून माणसापाशीं विचार असावा. विचारानें देव शोधावा. पुष्कळ देवांचा गोंधळ होऊं देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: There should be that thoughtless understanding and with that thoughtlessness, God should be searched out. Therefore keep this `I am' away from the entanglement of the `many' gods.

owis.original: देव क्षत्रीं पाहिला । त्यासारिखा धातूचा केला । पृथ्वीमधें दंडक चालिला । येणें रीतीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकानें एका क्षेत्रांत एक देव पाहिला.त्यासारखी धातूची एक मूर्ति तयार केली.जगांध्यें हा असा प्रकार चालत आला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Otherwise that God within the kshetra (within the sacred place) is taken as the `many' images made up of the metal and stone. And due to this, there are `many' rites and rituals in this world.

owis.original: नाना प्रतिमादेवांचें मूळ । तो हा क्षत्रदेवचि केवळ । नाना क्षत्रें भूमंडळ । शोधून पाहावें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: क्षेत्रामधील देव अनेक प्रतिमादेवांचे मूळ आहे. पृथ्वीवर अनेक क्षेत्रें आहेत ती शोधून पाहावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: The source of these images of god is the `many' thoughts, but that God of the kshetra (`all') is thoughtless. Therefore the `many' kshetras of this world should be searched through and understood.

owis.original: क्षत्रदेव पाषाणाचा । विचार पाहातां तयाचा । तंत लागला मुळाचा । अवताराकडे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: क्षेत्रांतील देव पाशाणाचा केलेला असतो. तो कसा झाला याचा विचार केला तर त्याचे मूळ एखाद्या अवतारापर्यंत पोचतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That God of the kshetra has been made into a stone image, but if you understand thoughtlessness then, you are He. And that thoughtlessness at the root can only be understood by means of this `all'.

owis.original: अवतारी देव संपले । देहे धरुनी वर्तोन गेले । त्याहून थोर अनुमानले । ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अवतारी देव तर संपले, ते देहांत आलें आणि मोठें कार्य करुन गेलें, ब्रह्मा, विष्णु व महेश हे तीन देव त्यांच्याहून मोठें अशी कल्पना केली.
owis.englishMeaning: But if that God within this `all' gets destroyed then, there is the staying in and the acting through the body. Then brahma, vishnu and mahesh (ie. three gunas) are considered to be greater than Him/brahman.

owis.original: त्या तिही देवांस ज्याची सत्ता । तो अंतरात्माचि पहातां । कर्ता भोक्ता तत्वता । प्रतक्ष आहे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण या तिन्ही देवांवर अंतरात्म्याची सत्ता चालते. खरें पाहिलें तर तोच प्रत्यक्ष कर्ता आहे व भोक्ता आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then the power of that purush is in possession of these three gods and that inner- atma that sees through the eyes of knowledge and who is truly the doer and enjoyer, sees through these eyes of flesh and the other sense organs.

owis.original: युगानयुगें तिन्ही लोक । येकचि चालवी अनेक । हा निश्र्चयाचा विवेक । वेदशास्त्रीं पाहावा ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा अंतरात्मा अनेक युगें तिन्ही लोक चालवतो आहे. तो स्वतः एकटा असून अनेकांस चालवतो. वेदशास्त्रांत असा निश्र्चयपूर्वक निर्णय केलेला आढळेल.
owis.englishMeaning: Age after age, in these three worlds, it is that One alone who makes the numerous different shapes to move. To have this conviction is vivek and that is the understanding of the vedas and shasthras (neti, neti; not this, not that). (maharaj- whatever is seen or perceived is not true; still He is there)

owis.original: आत्मा वर्तवितो शरीर । तोचि देव उत्तरोत्तर । जाणीवरुपें कळिवर । विवेकें वर्तवी ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा शरीर चालवतो. त्याचा शोध केला तर जाणिवेच्या रुपानें व विवेकानें तोच देव शरेर चालवतो अशी प्रचीति येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that atma, who makes this `all' body function and it is that God only that has become this `all'. When there is vivek then, you will understand that this corpse is functioning with this knowledge.

owis.original: तो अंतर्देव चुकती । धांवा घेऊन तीर्था जाती । प्राणी बापुडे कष्टती । देवास नेणतां ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या अंतर्देवाला लोक चुकतात. आणि तीर्थाकडे धांव घेतात. खरा देव कोणता तें न कळल्यानें बिचारीं माणसें कष्ट भोगतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But the jiva has forgotten that inner God and it runs to the various places of pilgrimage. In the prana, that One due to Its helplessness and foolishness, takes so much trouble and still It cannot know God.

owis.original: मग विचारिती अंतःकर्णी । जेथें तेथें धोंडा पाणी । उगेंचि वणवण हिंडोनि । काये होतें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तीर्थांत जाऊन न भेटल्यावर मगात्यांच्या मनांत असा विचार येतो कीं, प्रत्येक तीर्थामध्यें धोंडा व पाणी याशिवाय देसरें कांहींच नसतें. हें जर खरें तर उगीच वणवण फिरुन कांहींच फायदा नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there comes some proper thinking in the antah-karana. "Everywhere in these places, there is only stones and water. Why am I, that still and silent brahman, fruitlessly wandering around like this?"

owis.original: ऐसा ज्यासी विचार कळला । तेणें सत्संग धरिला । सतसंगें देव सांपडला । बहुत जनासी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा विचार बरोबर ज्याला कळतो,तो मग सतसंग धरतो. पुष्कळ लोकांना सत्संगानें देव सापडलेला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: And when thoughtlessness is understood by that purush then, He keeps the com- panionship of the Truth. When the mind keeps the companionship of the Truth, then this `all' and God have been found (prakruti/purush).

owis.original: ऐसीं हे विवेकाचीं कामें । विवेकी जाणतील नेमें । अविवेकी भुलले भ्रमें । त्यांस हें कळेना ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशीं हीं विवेकाची कामें आहेत. विवेकशील माणसांना ती बरोबर समजतात. भ्रमानें भुरळ पडलेली जीं विवेकहीन माणसें असतात, त्यांना हे कळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless Self needs to make such vivek and then, by proper practice of this, the viveki can come to understand thoughtlessness. However the a-viveki is confused, for he has totally forgotten Himself and then that thoughtless swarup can never understand Its own Self (ie. one can be that thoughtless Self only by being thoughtless).

owis.original: अंतरवेधी अंतर जाणे । बाहेरमुद्रा कांहींच नेणें । म्हणोन विवेकी शाहाणे । अंतर शोधिती ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतर्मुख होऊन जो आंत बघायला शिकतो त्यालाच अंतरंगामधून सूक्ष्माचें ज्ञान होतें. जो बहिर्मुख असतो त्याला या गोष्टी कांहींच कळत नाहींत. म्हणून जे विवेकी व शहाणें असतात तें आपलें अंतरंग शोधतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The one ever absorbed in this inner space knows only this inner space. While the one whose attention is turned outward does not know this `thing' even. Knowing this, the wise viveki goes on searching this inner space (for he longs to meet His thoughtless Self).

owis.original: विवेकेंविण जो भाव । तो भावचि अभाव । मूर्खस्य प्रतिमा देव । ऐसें वचन ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विवेकपूर्ण म्हणजे नीट समजून श्रद्धा ठेवणें आवशक आहे. विवेक न वापरता जी श्रद्धा ठेवली जाते ती एकप्रकारें अश्रद्धाच होय. " प्रतिमा मूर्खांचा देव असतो. " असें एक वचन आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush has no understanding of vivek then, that understanding becomes misunderstanding. Then this divine `speech' becomes the worship of a stone idol of the fool's god.

owis.original: पाहात समजत सेवटा गेला। तोचि विवेकी भला । तत्वें सांडुनी पावला । निरंजनीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विचारानें व साधनानें जो आंत पाहात गेला आणि अंतरंग समजत गेला तो शेवटास जातो. तो आत्मस्वरुपापर्यंत पोचतो. तोच उत्तम विवेकवान होय. अशाश्वत तत्वांना मागें टाकून तो निर्मळ ब्रह्मापर्यंत पोचतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But if there is intelligence and understanding right to the end (until all concepts are given up), then that purush becomes the wise viveki. Then the elements are left aside and He stays in parabrahman.

owis.original: आरे जे आकारासी येतें । तें अवघेंच नासोन जातें । मग गल्बल्यावेगळें तें । परब्रह्म जाणावें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अरें, जें जें कांहीं आकाराला येते, तें तें सर्व नाश पावतें. आकारमय अशाशव्ताच्या गोंधळापलीकडे राहणारें तें परब्रह्म होय.
owis.englishMeaning: My dear! When mula maya assumes a shape, then that Reality is surely destroyed by every thing. Therefore that parabrahman which is separate from all these confusions should be known

owis.original: चंचळ देव निश्र्चळ ब्रह्म । परब्रह्मीं नाहीं भ्रम । प्रत्ययज्ञानें निभ्रम । होईजेतें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव चंचळ तर परब्रह्म निश्र्चळ आहे. परब्रह्माच्या ठिकाणीं भ्रम नाहीं. आपण भ्रमांत आहोंत. म्हणून ब्रह्माचा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव घेऊन आपण भ्रमरहित व्हावें.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this talk of the moving God and that still brahman but in parabrahman there is no such confusion. Due to this knowledge of that nirgun, you will be freed from any delusion.

owis.original: प्रचीतीविण जें केलें । तें तें अवघें वेर्थ गेलें । प्राणी कष्टकष्टोंचि मेलें । कर्मकचाटें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनुभव न घेतां जें जें कांहीं आपण करतों तें सारें व्यर्थ जातें. कर्माच्या कचाट्यांत सापडून माणूस कष्ट भोगीत मरुन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: But when this mula maya does anything without this `experience' then, that Reality goes far away and there are the `many' futile and vain experiences. Then in the prana, that Reality that has taken so much trouble and toil dies due to its allotted karma.

owis.original: कर्मवेगळें न व्हावें । तरी देवास कासया भजावें । विवेकी जाणती स्वभावें । मूर्ख नेणे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कर्माहून जर वेगळें व्हायचे नाहीं, तर मग देवाचे भजन कशासाठीं करायचे? विवेकी पुरुषांना हें बरोबर समजतें. मूर्खांना नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If one is not separate from this karma then, how can there be the bhajan of God (ie. within every action, I am in my swarup)? The viveki naturally knows that which the foolish do not know. (If I am the Witness then, I cannot be anything that is seen or perceived. Then, naturally I remain untouched by whatever so called, fruits of past actions or karma that appears before me. By detachment there can be the proper enjoyment of the already created karma without adding to it further)

owis.original: कांहीं अनुमानलें विचारें । देव आहे जगदांतरें । सगुणाकरितां निर्धारें । निर्गुण पाविजे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विचार केला तर देव जगाच्या अंतर्यामी भरुन आहे अशी कल्पना येते. त्याला भजण्यास सगुणाचाच आधार घेतला पाहिजे. अशारीतीनें सगुणाची उपासना केली कीं, निश्र्चयानें निर्गुणाची प्राप्ती होते.
owis.englishMeaning: This `thing' is the conjecture of that thoughtless Self and then, due to this inner space of the world there is that God (prakruti/purush). Still by means of this sagun, that nirgun God should be attained.

owis.original: सगुण पाहातां मुळास गेला । सहजचि निर्गुण पावला । संगत्यागें मोकळा जाला । वस्तुरुप ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नामरुप सगुणाचा शोध घेतां घेतां उपासक मूळमायेपर्यंत पोचतो. तेथें त्याला सहजच निर्गुणाची प्राप्ती होते. उपासनेच्या शेवटीं उपासक मीपणानें संपूर्ण नाहींसा होतो. म्हणजेच तो सर्व दृश्यरुप सगुणापासून मोकळा होतो. असा मोकळा होऊन तो ब्रह्मरुप होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And when you have gone to this root and when you have seen this sagun then, understand that, in truth, it is natural nirgun that has done this. Then, giving up all company and attachment, this form of the Self (ie. sagun), is set free (when one realizes that this sagun understanding is the nirgun seeking Its Self, then the companionship of this sagun can be given up).

owis.original: परमेश्र्वरीं अनुसंधान । लावितां होईजे पावन । मुख्य ज्ञानेंचि विज्ञान । पाविजेतें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अमतरात्म्याचे अखंड अनुसंधान लावावें. तें लागलें कीं, मनुष्य पावन होतो. त्याला आत्मज्ञान होतें. पुढें विज्ञान प्राप्त होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When you place this sagun connection in parameshwara then, that pure Self will be attained. On account of there being only this One pure knowledge, that vignyan/beyond knowledge should be acquired (everything we see and perceive is that One appearing. This `I' is that One appearing as another).

owis.original: ऐसीं हे विवेकाचीं विवर्णें । पाहावीं सुचित अंतःकर्णें । नित्यानित्यविवेकश्रवणें । जगदोदहार ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरण एकाग्र करावें आणि विवेकानें अशा प्रकारचे विवरण करावें. नित्यानित्यविवेकाच्या श्रवणानें जगाचा उद्धार होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless Self makes vivek then, his antah-karana will become pure. Therefore first there should be listening. It is the vivek between the indestructible and the destructible and due to this, one is lifted out of this mundane existence. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: वंदूनियां आदिपुरुष । बोलों निद्रेचा विळास । निद्रा आलियां सावकास । जाणार नाहीं ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आदिपुरुषाला वंदन करुन निद्रेचा विलास सांगतो. एकदां का झोप आली कीं, ती सहज जात नाहीं.माणसाला झोप अवावरपणें येतें.
owis.englishMeaning: I bow down to that original-purush (ie. the One who never sleeps), for this `speech' is the `play' of sleep (ie. this sleep is knowledge and it is ignorance of that Reality). But sleep has come to this knowledge and it will not go away (when this maya of knowledge was forgotten, there was the maya of ignorance. Then the gunas and elements manifested and there was the thought, "I am a body").

owis.original: निद्रेनें व्यापिली काया । आळस आंग मोडे जांभया । तेणेंकरितां बैसावया । धीर नाहीं ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: झोपेनें शरीर व्यापलें म्हणजे सुस्ती येतें. अंग मोडून येते व जांभया येऊं लागतात. माणसाला मग बसवत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this sleep, this `all' body has been covered over and then this gross body yields to laziness and yawns. On account of this, patience and fortitude are not maintained.

owis.original: कडकडां जांभया येती । चटचटां चटक्या वाजती । डकडकां डुकल्या देती । सावकास ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: झोप आलेल्या माणसाला कडकडा जांभया येतात. तो चटाचट चुटक्या वाजवतो. आणि डकाडक डुलक्या खाऊं लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this `all' body is a gross body and there is the making of loud sounds and noisy yawns and there is the cracking of joints and flopping and rolling around.

owis.original: येकाचे डोळे झांकती । येकाचे डोळे लागती । येक ते वचकोन पाहाती । चहुंकडे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: झोप आली कीं, एखाद्याचे डोळे मिटतात. एखाद्याचे डोळे अर्धवट लागतात. आणि एखादा दचकून इकडेतिकडे पाहुं लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The eyes of that One (ie. that One who never sleeps and His eyes are knowledge) are then filled with tiredness. His eyes may be completely shut (ie. He may be fast asleep in body consciousness) or He may look around in all directions with awe at the wonder of this `all' (but still, even in this knowledge, is the sleep of ignorance).

owis.original: येक उलथोन पडिले । तिहीं ब्रह्मविणे फोडिले । हुडकाचे टुकडे जाले । सुधी नाहीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: झोपेच्या भरांत कीर्तन ऐकायला बसलेला माणूस एकदम उताणा पडतो. तो बुवाच्या विणेवर पडल्यानें विणा फुटते किंवा हुडकी नांवाच्या वाद्यावर पदल्यानें तिचे तुकडे होतात. पण त्या माणसाला त्याची शुद्ध नसते.
owis.englishMeaning: That One has turned Its attention outwards and fallen into this gross body; that One has broken Its connection with brahman and searches around in semi-consciousness for Its broken parts (ie. in knowledge and ignorance/rajo guna that unbroken Self says, "Please somebody, something give me happiness." Every jiva is seeking completion in the incomplete).

owis.original: येक टेकोन बैसले । तेथेंचि घोरों लागले । येक उताणें पसरले । सावकास ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा टेकून बसलेला बसल्याबसल्याच घोरायला लागतो. एखादा हळुहळु उताणा पसरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One settles lazily into this lump of flesh and bones and goes sound asleep. That One has been scattered all over and then this knowledge lazily reclines in a gross body.

owis.original: कोणी मुर्कुंडी घालिती । कोणी कानवडें निजती । कोणी चक्रीं फिरती । चहुंकडे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा मुर्कुडी घालून निजतो. तर एखादा कुशीवर झोपीं जातो. एखादा झोपेंमध्यें वाटोळा लोळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In this sleep of ignorance, that One becomes a body and sleeps in his mother's womb; in this sleep of ignorance, that One within this `all' takes a birth and lies sleeping on its side. Then that One within this `all', whirls about and wanders around in all directions. (First that brahman falls asleep and there is knowledge; then this knowledge falls asleep and there is body consciousness)

owis.original: येक हात हालविती । येक पाये हालविती । येक दांत खाती । कर्कराटें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: झोपेंत एखादा हात तर एखादा पाय हलवतो. तर एखादा कराकरा दांत खातो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One is made to move these hands; and that One is made to move these feet. That One makes a noise by grinding his teeth together. (Objectivity has drowned that One and He thinks He is a solid body of bones and flesh and blood. But it is just a dream)

owis.original: येकाचीं वस्त्रें निघोनि गेलीं । ते नागवींच लोळों लागलीं २ येकाचीं मुंडासीं गडबडलीं । चहुंकडे ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्याचे कपडे जागेवर राहार नाहींत. मगतो नागवाच लोळतो. तर एखाद्याच्या डोक्याचे मुंडासे सगळीकडे पसरते.
owis.englishMeaning: By the covering over of that One, there is this disguise and then that Reality, naked and lost, starts crying and begging. That One becomes a servant to the mind and runs bewildered in every direction.

owis.original: येक निजेलीं अव्यावेस्तें । येक दिसती जैसीं प्रेते । दांत पसरुनी जैसीं भूतें । वाईट दिसती ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा अस्ताव्यस्त पडलेला असतो. तर एखादा अगदी प्रेतासारखा दिसतो. तर एखादा दांत पसरलेल्या भुतासारखा अगदीं वाईट दिसतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One is asleep in disorder and confusion and then that One sees by means of this corpse. That One with controlled passions has been scattered all around due to the elements and It sees this gross existence.

owis.original: येक वोसणतचि उठिले । येक अंधारीं फिरों लागले । येक जाऊन निजेले । उकरड्यावरी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा बडबडत उठतो. तर एखादा अंधारांत फिरु लागतो. तर एखादा सरळ उकिरड्यावर जाऊन निजतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One talks in Its sleep (`I am' it says) and then gets up and wanders around in the darkness. That One who is fast asleep goes and sits upon this dung-heap (ie. the gross body).

owis.original: येक मडकीं उतरिती । येक भोई चांचपती । येक उठोन वाटा लागती । भलतीकडे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा शिंक्यावरची मडकी उतरवतो. तर एखादा जमीन चाचपतो. तर एखादा उठून झोपेंतच भलत्या वाटेंनें चालूं लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One has been placed in this `earthen pot' and then that One searches around for something amongst the many other things. That One wakes up from this sleep but then, starts to take the wrong path once again.

owis.original: येक प्राणी वोसणाती । येक फुंदफुंदों रडती । येक खदखदां हांसती । सावकास ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा उगीच ओरडत उठतो. तर एखादा स्फूंदून रडतो. तर एखादा खदखदा हासत सुटतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One in the prana, talks in this sleep. That One doesn't stop bragging. That One became this knowledge and then started crying and laughing aloud.

owis.original: येक हाका मारुं लागले । येक बोंबलित उठिले । येक वचकोन राहिले । आपुले ठाईं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखदा हांका मारतो तर एखादा शंख करीत उठतो. तर एखादा निजलेला दचकून उठून बसतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One started shouting; that One gets up flustered and confused or that One is filled with awe and remains in His own place.

owis.original: येक क्षणक्षणा खुरडती । येक डोई खाजविती । येक कढों लागती । सावकास ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा क्षणक्षणाला पायानें खुरडतो. तर एखादा डोकें खाजवतो. तर एखादा सारखा कण्हत असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One spends every moment crawling around; that One scratches its head in confusion and that One who appeared as this knowledge then, becomes hot with pas- sion.

owis.original: येकाच्या लाळा गळाल्या । येकाच्या पिका सांडल्या । येकीं लघुशंका केल्या । सावकास ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्याची लाळ गळते. तर एखाद्याची पिंक तोंडांतून सांडते. तर एखाद्याला झोपेंतर लघवी होते.
owis.englishMeaning: That One becomes intimate and kisses. That One spits tobacco from his mouth. And that One who had appeared as this knowledge then, goes and urinates.

owis.original: येक राउत सोडिती । येक कर्पट ढेंकर देती । येक खांकरुनी थुंकिती । भलतीकडे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादाला वारा सरतो तर एखाद्याला करपट ढेकरा येतात. तर एखादा झोपेंतच खांकरुन भलतीकडेच थुंकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One farts loudly and that One makes a stinking belch. That One coughs and spits in any direction.

owis.original: येक हागती येक वोकिती । येक खोंकिती येक सिंकिती । येक ते पाणी मागती । निदसुर्‍या स्वरें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्याला झोपेंत शौचाला होते तर एखादा ओकारी करतो. एखादा खोंकतो तर एखादा शिंकतो. तर एखादा झोपेंतच झोपाळू आवाजांत पाणी मागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One throws mucus from his nose and that One passes a stool and that One vomits. That One coughs and that One sneezes and that Reality, half asleep asks for water.

owis.original: येक दुस्वप्नें निर्बुजले । येक सुस्वप्नें संतोषले । येक ते गाढमुढी पडिले । सुषुप्तिमधें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा वाईट स्वप्न बघून घाबरतो तर एखादा चांगलें स्वप्न पाहून खूष होतो. तर एखादाअगदी गाढ झोपेंत स्वस्थ पडलेला असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One is confounded and scared by this bad dream and that One feels contented when his dream is happy. But that Reality has fallen in this deep sleep of ignorance.

owis.original: इकडे उजेडाया जालें । कोण्हीं पढणें आरंभिलें । कोणीं प्रातस्मरामि मांडिलें । हरिकीर्तन ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इकडे दिवस उगवण्याची वेळ झालीकीं एखादा नित्यपाठ आरंभ करतो. तर एखादा प्रातःस्मरण करतो. आणि हरिकिर्तन सुरु करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Here a little light came and that One began to study. That One established the practice of remembering God in the morning and that One made kirtana.

owis.original: कोणीं आठविल्या ध्यानमूर्ति । कोणी येकांतीं जप करिती । कोणी पाठांतर उजळिती । नाना प्रकारें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा ध्यानमूर्ति मनांत आठवतो. तर एखादा एकांतांत बसून जप करतो. तर एखादा अनेक प्रकारानें आपल्या पाठांतराची उजळणी करुं लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One remembered and meditated upon an image of God; that One made japa in a quiet place and that One revised and learnt by heart `many' passages from the scriptures.

owis.original: नाना विद्या नाना कळा । आपलाल्या सिकती सकळा । तानमानें गायेनकळा । येक गाती ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्येकजण आपापल्या विद्या व कला शिकूं लागतो. एखादा तानाबीना घेऊन गायनकलेचा अभ्यास करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One practiced the `many' learnings and the `many' arts. While that One gained knowledge of this `all' and then, that One sang this harmonious `song'.

owis.original: मागें निद्रा संपली । पुढें जागृति प्राप्त जाली । वेवसांई बुद्धि आपुली । प्रेरिते जाले ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रात्रीची झोप झाली मग चांगली जाग आली. प्रत्येकजण आपापल्या व्यवसायांत लक्ष घालूं लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: Afterwards, when wakefulness came and His sleep of ignorance was over, that One sent away His worldly buddhi.

owis.original: ज्ञाता तत्वें सांडून पळाला । तुर्येपलिकडे गेला । आत्मनिवेदनें जाला । ब्रह्मरुप ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्ञानी पुरुष दृश्य असणारीं अशाश्वत तत्वें टाकून दूर सरतो, तुर्येच्यापलीकडे जातो आणि संपूर्ण आत्मनिवेदन करुन ब्रह्मरुप होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That Knower left these elements and went to the side beyond this turya state (ie. beyond witnessing). In this way, this brahman-form (`all') was surrendered to that atma. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Shrota Avalakshan Nirupan (A Discourse on the Faults of a Listener)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: कोणीयेका कार्याचा साक्षप । कांहीं तर्‍ही घडे विक्षेप । काळ साहे तें आपोंआप । होत जातें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण एखादे कार्य सिद्ध करण्यासाठीं उद्योग आरंभला तर कांहींतरी विघ्न येते पण काळाचें सहाय्य असेल तर तें कार्य आपोआप होत जातें.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that One within everyone and this steadfast, determined action of the `thing'. But when confusion and bewilderment appears upon this `thing' then, death has to be endured and due to body consciousness, that natural and ever-shining Self, has to come and go.

owis.original: कार्यभाग होत चालिला । तेणें प्राणी शोक जाला । विचारहि सूचों लागला । दिवसेंदिवस ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कार्यामध्यें जसजशी प्रगती होत जाते तसतसा काम करणार्‍या माणसाचा उत्साह वाढत जातो. दिवसेंदिवस त्याला नवें नवें विचार सुचु लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This action of the `all thing' was naturally flowing by but then in the prana, sorrow appeared (ie. sorrow or desire or anger etc. arose and this understanding was drowned; if this `all' understanding is not very carefully maintained then, in a blink of an eye, body consciousness will arise). Therefore day after day, this `all' is to be maintained and then thoughtlessness can be imbibed (if you remain in knowledge, feeling safe in this accomplishment then, be warned. Without understanding that thoughtless Self, the mind or body consciousness will return like a thief and steal your understanding away).

owis.original: कोणीयेक प्राणी जन्मासी येतो । कांहीं तर्‍ही काळ साहे होतो । दुःखाउपरी सुख देतो । देव कृपाळुपणें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत असे आढळतें, कीं, एखादा माणूस जन्मास येतो. त्याला कांहींतरी काळाची अनुकूलता सहाय्य करते. प्रथम तो दुःख भोगतो. पण त्यानंतर देवाच्या कृपाळूपणानें त्याला सुख लाभते.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One within everyone takes birth in the prana then, this `thing' has to endure the ravages of time and death. After such suffering, God kindly gives happiness (ie. troubles are there for your own good. They bring that longing to be with God).

owis.original: अवघाचि काळ जरी सजे । तरी अवघेचि होती राजे । कांहीं सजे कांहीं न सजे । ऐसें आहे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: काळ जर नेहमींच अनुकुल राहून सहाय करुं लागला तर सगळेच राजे होतील. पण कांहीं प्रसंगीं काळ अनुकूल तर कांहीं प्रसंगीप्रतिकूल असा क्रम जीवनांत चालतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If the mind full of the `many' things is made ready for this time of the `all' (ie. the Master's words are churned over/vivek), then the mind becomes committed (ie. the conviction, `I am He' arises and there is the patience and fortitude of this determined action). This `thing' can either be made ready or this `thing' may not be made ready (and one will remain an ignorant jiva). The choice is yours!

owis.original: येहलोक अथवा परलोक । साधतां कोणीयेक विवेक । अद्भुत होये स्वभाविक । देणें ईश्र्वराचें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रपंचांत किंवा परमार्थांत जर खरा विवेक करणें साधलें तर सहजरीतीनें कांहींतरी अद्भुत कार्य हातुन घडतें. हें असें घडणें हें ईश्र्वरीकृपेचेच फळ होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Either there is this world or the world beyond. If that One within everyone makes vivek then, this wonder of the `all' will naturally appear; for this is a gift from ishwara (ishwara is the Witness).

owis.original: ऐकल्याविण कळलें । शिकल्याविण शहाणपण आलें । देखिलें ना ऐकिलें । भूमंडळीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाकडून ऐकल्यावांचून कळतें. कोणाकडून शिकल्यावांचून शहाणपण आलें. असें जगांत कोणी कधीम पाहिलें नाहीं किंवा ऐकलें नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: For it has never been seen or heard of that the understanding of nirgun was gained without listening to this sagun discourse. Or that there has been wisdom without it first being learnt.

owis.original: सकळ कांहीं ऐकतां कळे । कळतां कळतां वृत्ति निवळे । नेमस्त मनामधें आकळे । सारासार ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुसर्‍याकडून ऐकून सर्व कांहीं कळूं लागते. असें कळत गेल्यानें आपली वृत्ती निवळते आणि मग सार कोणतें व असार कोणतें, याचें निश्र्चित ज्ञान आपल्या मनाला आकलन होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore understood and listen to this `all thing' and when this understanding is continuously maintained then, this knowing vritti will become clear and pure, and this limited jiva within the mind will understand that thoughtless essence (ie. no-mind).

owis.original: श्रवण म्हणिजे ऐकावें । मनन म्हणिजे मनीं धरावें । येणें उपायें स्वभावें । त्रयलोक्य चाले ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रवण म्हणजें ऐकणें होय. मनन म्हणजें मनांत धरणें होय. मनन म्हणजे धारणा. याच उपायानें त्रैलोक्यांतील ज्ञानव्यवहार चालत आलेला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: shravan means to listen to this `I am'. manana means to hold this in the mind. Due to these, there is this remedy of the spontaneous `all' on which the three worlds function.

owis.original: श्रवणाआड विक्षेप येती । नाना जिनस सांगों किती । सावध असतां प्रत्यय येती । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रवणाचा उपयोग होण्यास ज्या अडचणी येतात, त्यांचे सगळें प्रकार सांगणें शक्य नाहीं. मनुष्य जर सावध राहिला तर त्या अडचणींची कल्पना त्याला येते.
owis.englishMeaning: But if shravan is obstructed then confusion arises. Therefore this confusion of the `many' objects should be made that thoughtless swarup. But it is only when you listen very attentively, that this sagun `thing' becomes that thoughtless nirgun.

owis.original: श्रवणीं लोक बैसले । बोलतां बोलतां येकाग्र जाले । त्याउपरी जे नूतन आले । ते येकाग्र नव्हेती ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा लोक ऐकायला बसले आणि वक्त्याचे बोलणें ऐकतां ऐकतां एकाग्र झालें. पण नंतर नंतर म्हणजे उशीरानें येणारे लोक एकाग्र नसतात. त्यांचा आधीच्या लोकांना विक्षेप होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one is seated in this world of shravan and there is this continuous `speech' of `I am' then, this is the one-pointed attention of manana. This is mula maya and it brings the `ever new' (ie. being in the endless `now'). And afterwards when even this attentiveness is not, then that is Reality.

owis.original: मनुष्य बाहेर हिंडोनी आलें । नाना प्रकारीचें ऐकिलें । उदंड गलबलूं लागलें । उगें असेना ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा मनुष्य पुष्कळ ठिकाणीं हिंडून येतो. तो अनेक प्रकारचे ऐकून येतो. फार ऐकल्यानें त्याच्या मनांत घोटाळा उत्पन्न होतो. त्याला मग चैन पडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Mankind has wandered and strayed so far outside and heard about so `many' dif- ferent ways that, that vast paramatma has become confused and that silent and still, is as if not there.

owis.original: प्रसंग पाहोन चालती । ऐसे लोक थोडे असती । श्रवणीं नाना विक्षेप होती । ते हे ऐका ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रसंगओळखून वागणारे लोक थोडेच असतात. त्यामुळें श्रवणांत येणार्‍या अडचणी अनेक प्रकारच्या असतात. त्यापैकीं कांहीं ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Few are there in the world who understand this `all' connection and function ac- cording to it. Therefore when the `many' confusions appear within shravan then, one should only listen and afterwards there will be that thoughtless swarup.

owis.original: श्रवणीं बैसले ऐकाया । अडों लागली काया । येती कडकडां जांभया । निद्राभरें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सभेमध्यें ऐकायला बसलें कीं, शरीर अवघडतें. त्यांत फार झोप आल्यामुळें सारख्या जांभया येऊं लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: During shravan, listening was settled into but then the body became restless or the drug of sleep brought loud yawning.

owis.original: बैसले सुचित करुनि मना । परी तें मनचि ऐकेना । मागें होतें ऐकिलें नाना । तेंचि धरुनी बैसलें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा माणूस मन शांत करुन ऐकायला बसतो. पण त्याचे मन ऐकत नाहीं. पूर्वीं जें ऐकलेले असेल तेंच मनांत सारखें येऊं लागते. त्यामुळें वक्ता जें सांगत असतो त्याकडे लक्ष लागत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The mind had been calmed in order to be very alert but that mind did not `listen' and it sat with and held on to the `many' things it had heard before.

owis.original: तत्पर केलें शरीर । परी मनामधें आणीक विचार । कल्पना कल्पी तो विस्तार । किती म्हणौनि सांगावा ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीर अगदी आवरुन ऐकायला बसलें तर मनांत इतर विचार येऊं लागतात. एकामागून एक कल्पना विस्तार घेऊं लागतात. त्या सगळ्या सांगणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This `all' body was made very attentive (ie. everything is forgotten), but then in the mind there came more and more thoughts and due to imagination, these imagined thoughts increased. Therefore the `many' thoughts should understand thoughtlessness.

owis.original: जें जें कांहीं श्रवणीं पडिलें । तितुकें समजोन विवरलें । तरीच कांहीं सार्थक जालें । निरुपणीं ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें आपण ऐकतो तें नीट समजून त्यावर मनन केलें तरच निरुपणानें कांहीं सार्थक झालें असें म्हणावें.
owis.englishMeaning: This `thing' within shravan is to be very carefully listened to and understood and then, this `thing' is to be investigated further. For it has to be clearly understood that this `thing' of your discourse, is not the accomplishment of that nirgun.

owis.original: मन दिसतें मां धरावें । ज्याचें त्यानें आवरावें । आवरुन विवेकें धरावें । अर्थांतरी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मन जर दिसत असतें तर त्याला धरतां आलें असतें. तें दिसत नाहीं म्हणून ज्याचे त्यानें मन आवरावे. तसें तें आवरुन विवेकानें तें अर्थ शोधण्याकडे गुंतवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Wherever the mind looks and whatever it sees, still this sagun discourse should be firmly held. In this way, the mind should be gathered up and controlled (everything seen and perceived is all knowledge only; no further objectification is necessary or should take place). Having gathered up this inner space of sagun by vivek, that nirgun meaning should then be firmly held (why is this knowledge even required when I am One without another?).

owis.original: निरुपणीं येऊन बैसला । परी तो उदंड जेऊन आला । बैसतांच कासाविस जाला । त्रुषाकांत ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा एखादा माणूस भरपेट जेवला आणि निरुपणाला येऊन बसला, बसल्याबसल्या तो तहानेनें कासावीस झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: In this sagun discourse you came and sat (by forgetting everything) but that para- matma had been previously enjoying the fruits of Its past actions and so while sitting in this discourse, quickly it became uneasy with longings (ie. habits of lifetimes are hard to break; for so long that ever free paramatma had been taken Itself as a body).

owis.original: आधीं उदक आणविलें । घळघळां उदंड घेतलें । तेणें मळमळूं लागलें । उठोनी गेला ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून त्यानें पाणी आणविलें आणि ते घटाघटा पोटभर प्यायला. मग त्याच्या पोटांत मळमळूं लागलें. म्हणून तो उठून गेला. अशाप्रकारें त्याचें श्रवण हुकलें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this great water element gets brought to this discourse you were listening to (ie. objectification caused by the habits and desires appears upon this `I am' and a world of `many' forms appears) and that vast paramatma freely accepts these and forgets Its Self. Due to this, uneasiness arises and that One gets up and leaves (thoughts come and disturb this discourse with that One; then It leaves Its `aloneness' and accepts duality).

owis.original: कर्पट ढेंकर उचक्या देती । वारा सरतां मोठी फजिती । क्षणाक्षणा उठोनी जाती । लघुशंकेसी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्याला सारख्या करपट ढेकरा येतात. एखादा सारख्या उचक्या देतो. तर एखाद्याचा वारासरुन मोठी फजिती होते. एखाद्याला वारंवार लघुशंकेसाठीं उठून जावें लागतें. या सर्वांचे श्रवण नीट होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is belching, hiccoughs, the loud passing of wind and bad smells. Such is this ridiculous condition within that great brahman (maharaj- maya tries to shame you into accepting body consciousness). Then that `moment of the One' gets up and goes to urinate (in every action one should remain in one's Self; don't take the touch. "I do not go to the toilet. He is everything, everywhere").

owis.original: दिशेनें कासाविस केला । आवघेंचि सांडून धांविला । निरुपणप्रसंगी निघोनी गेला । अखंड ऐसा ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्यास मधेच शौचास लागते. तो अगदी अस्वस्थ होतो व सगळें सोडून धांवत जातो. अशारीतीनें कांहीं ना कांहीं कारणानें निरुपणाच्यावेळीं नेहमी माणूस गैरहजर असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the need to defecate, there is uneasiness and due to the `many' thoughts the mind leaves this `I am' discourse and runs away towards these thoughts. Then that unbroken brahman within this sagun discourse, gets up and goes outside again (that unbroken Self gets continually broken by the thoughts and desires and it returns to body consciousness).

owis.original: दृष्टांतीं कांहीं अपूर्व आलें । अंतःकर्ण तेथेंचि राहिलें । कोठवरी काये वाचिलें । कांहीं कळेना ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वक्त्यानें एखादा अपूर्व दृष्टांत सांगितला तर मन त्यालाच चिकटून राहाते. मग ग्रंथाचे वाचन कुठचे झालें याचे भान राहात नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But if this `thing' brings thoughtlessness then, this knowing will remain `there' only. For then there is no place and nothing to be witnessed and this `thing' also will not remain (`there' this knowledge is absorbed and witnessing does not remain).

owis.original: निरुपणीं येऊन बैसला । तो विंचुवें फणकाविला । कैंचे निरुपण जाला । कासावीस ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा निरुपणाला येुन बसतो व त्याला विंचू चावतो. मग कसलें आलें निरुपण? त्याचा जीव नुसता कासावीस होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But if the one who comes and sits in this sagun discourse (`I am He') gets bitten by the scorpions of desire then, how can there be this `I am' discourse when there is so much distress?

owis.original: पोटामधें तिडिक उठिली । पाठीमधें करक भरली । चालक चिखल्या पुळी जाली । बैसवेना ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पोटांत कळ आली, पाठींत उसण भरली, संधिॉतानें सांधें धरलें, पायाच्या बोटांत चिखल्या झाल्या, बसायच्या जागीं पुळी झाली, तर माणसाला निरुपणाला बसवत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If within the support of this sagun discourse, care and concern arises (ie. atta- chment); or if within this support of this sagun discourse, pain appears then, that which makes everything move appears as this filthy ulcer called the body and one cannot remain sitting in this sagun discourse. (maharaj this body is a boil on you)

owis.original: पिसोळा चाऊन पळाला । तेणें प्राणी दुश्र्चीत जाला । कोणें नेटें गल्बला केला । तेथेंचि धावें ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा पिसोळ पाहून पळाला तर मनाची एकाग्रता भंगून जातें. तेवढ्यांत बाहेर कोणी खूप गडबड केली तर माणूस निरुपण सोडून तिकडे धावतो.
owis.englishMeaning: A small insect bites and runs away (maharaj- a thought is like a mosquito) and due to that, there is inattentiveness in the prana. Then that one starts to gossip outside and that brahman runs there. 11 duschit-To forget one's Self

owis.original: विषई लोक श्रवणीं येती । ते बायेकांकडेच पाहाती । चोरटे लोक चोरुन जाती । पादरक्षा ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कामवासनेने पछाडलेले लोक श्रवण करायला येतात पण त्यांचें लक्ष स्त्रियांकडे असतें. आणि चोर श्रवणास आलेल्या लोकांची पादत्राणेंच चोरुन नेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When this world of the sense objects appears within your shravan then, that One looks towards the ladies and due to the thief called mind, this world of knowledge that protects `His feet'/understanding is stolen away.

owis.original: होये नव्हे वादवेवाद । तेणें उदंड जाला खेद । सिव्या गाळी अप्रमाद । होतां चुकला ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या प्रसंगीं श्रवण करीत असतां " अस्ति आणि नास्ति " असा वाद होतो. त्यामुळें मनाला मोठा खेद होतो. कारण त्यामधें शिव्याशाप होतात. आगळीक घडते. आपल्या हातून चूक घडतें. अर्थांत श्रवण बाजूलाच राहून जातें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then "it is" or "it is not" is disputed (there is only yourself in the world; no effort is requires to be and to know; but then you say, "Am I there or not?") and due to this, that vast paramatma starts arguing and then It has to swallow a torrent of abuse by those who don't know and have forgotten their Self.

owis.original: कोणीं निरुपणी बैसती । सावकास गोष्टी लाविती । हरिदास ते रें रें करिती । पोटासाठीं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं लोक निरुपण श्रवणास बसतात. पण आपसांत गप्पा सुरु करतात. समोत हरिदास मात्र पोटासाठीं रटाळ किर्तन करत असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Someone came and sat in this discourse and made this effortless `story' (`I am'). But then this `servant of hari' (ie. devoted to knowing) makes friendship with his mind, on account of his belly.

owis.original: बहुत जाणते मिळाले । येकापुढें येक बोले । लाकांचे आशये राहिले । कोण जाणे ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादे प्रसंगी पुष्कळ विद्वान लोक निरुपणास येतात. तेच एकामागून एक बोलूं लागतात. इतर श्रोत्यांना काय हवें इकडे कोणीच लक्ष देत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Now when due to knowing, this `all' has been met then, this sagun is `speaking' in front of that nirgun. So still, this original doubt `I am' remains; but who is there who understands this? (This `I am' should not be taken as the Truth)

owis.original: माझें होये तुझें नव्हे । ऐसा अखंड जयास सवे । न्याये नीति सांडून धावे । अन्यायाकडे ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माझेंच म्हणणें खरें तुझे म्हणणे खरें नाहीं, असा हेका धरण्याची सवय कांहीं लोकांस असते. अशी माणसें न्यायनीति सोडून अन्यायाकडे धांव घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: `I am and you are not'; then that unbroken Self, of Its own accord, has become mula maya. Justice and equanimity are left aside and then, It runs along the path of injustice.

owis.original: आपल्या थोरपणासाठीं । अच्यावाच्या तोंड पिटी । न्याये नाहीं ते सेवटीं । परम अन्याई ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्याला मोठेपणा यावा यासाठीं कांहीं माणसें आच्यावाच्या बोलत सुटतात. त्यांचें बोलणें कांहीं न्यायाचे नसतें. अखेर ते अगदी अन्यायाचे ठरतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then It babbles without proper thought just to prove Its own greatness. When there is no justice then, that Supreme commits the sin of being a body.

owis.original: येकेकडे अभिमान उठे । दुसरेकडे उदंड पेटे । ऐसे श्रोते खरे खोटे । कोण जाणे ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकजण गर्वानें बोलत सुटतो तर दुसरा भयंकर संतापतो. अशा प्रकारच्या श्रोत्यांमधे खरा कोण व खोटा कोण हें सांगणें कठिण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: In the company of that One Supreme, there may be the swelling up of the pride `I am' or due to the company of this `I am', that vast paramatma may be kindled. In this way, the listener can become the Truth (ie. nirgun) or remain as this false sagun. But who is there who can know the difference?

owis.original: म्हणोन जाणते विचक्षण । तें आधींच धरिती नेणपण । मूर्ख टोणपा आपण । कांहींच नाहीं ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून जे खरें जाणते व शहाणे असतात, ते प्रथमच स्वतःकडे नेणतेपणा घेतात. आपण मूर्ख आहोत, अज्ञानी आहोत, आपण कोणींच नाहीं अशी भूमिका तें घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore, this knowing brings wisdom when, at the source, that Reality maintains, `I know nothing'. But you become foolish and dull-minded when this `thing' is not known (and say, "I know so much").

owis.original: आपणाहून देव थोर । ऐसा जयास कळला विचार । सकळ कांहीं जगदांतर । तेहिं राखावें ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्याहून देव थोर आहे हा विचार ज्याला खर्‍या अर्थानें समजला, तो सगळ्या लोकांचें अंतःकरण सांभालतो.जनीं जनार्दन आहे अशी त्याची खात्री असल्यानें तो समुदायाचे अंतःकरण दुखवीत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But when thoughtessness is understood by mula maya then, you have understand that God is greater than yourself (ie. for you have surrendered yourself to the atma). Therefore this `all thing' within this world of `many' things should be protected until that time comes.

owis.original: सभेमधें कळ्हो जाला । शब्द येतो जाणत्याला । अंतरें राखों नाहीं सिकला । कैसा योगी ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सभेमध्यें जर भांडण निर्माण झालें, तर त्याचा दोष जाणत्याकडे जातो. जों लोकांचें अंतःकरण सांभाळू शकत नाहीं तो योगी म्हणवून घेण्यास योग्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If in this meeting place of the `all', a quarrel is allowed to erupt then, that Knower has to be blamed (you the Knower have given away your understanding for irrelevant thoughts). He has not learnt to keep this inner space protected and therefore how can he be called a yogi?

owis.original: वैर करितां वैरचि वाढे । आपणास दुःख भोगणें घडे । म्हणोनि शाहाण्याचे कुकडे । कळों आलें ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वैर केल्यानें वैर वाढतें. आणि आपल्याला दुःख भोगावें लागतें. यावरुन शहाणपणाचे रहस्य ध्यानांत येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: If you create enmity then, enmity only increases and you yourself are made to suffer for it. Therefore the secret of wisdom is to be understood (ie. witnessing is wisdom. Your mind is your worst enemy and it is your best friend. Teach your mind. Convince your mind that nothing is there and when it is convinced then, it will never turn. Then you will see yourself everywhere).

owis.original: अखंड आपणा सांभाळिती । क्षुल्लकपण येऊं नेदिती । थोर लोकांस क्ष्मा शांति । अगत्य करणें ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो खरा थोर असतो तो नेहमीं आपला थोरपणा सांभाळून वागतो. आपल्याकडे हीनपणा तो येऊं देत नाहीं. थोर लोकांच्या वागण्यांत क्षमा व शांती हे गुण अति आवश्यक असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If you always protect yourself properly then, `smallness' is never allowed to enter within. Then that (great) brahman will regard the world with peace and forgiveness.

owis.original: अवगुणापासीं बैसला गुणी । आवगुण कळतो तत्क्षणीं । विवेकी पुरुषाची करणी । विवेकें होते ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अवगुणी माणसाच्या संगतीला गुणवान माणूस राहिला तर त्याला अवगुण ताबडतोप ध्यानांत येतात. जो विवेकी बनतो त्याच्या हातून विवेकी पुरुषासारखेंच वर्तन घडतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When that virtuous Knower sits near the un-virtuous (ie. the indisciplined mind) then, at that very moment, the un-virtuous comes to understand (in your mind you will feel, "Oh, a change has come". Your own mind will be your best judge). But this action of the viveki purush can only appear if you make vivek (ie. it is not an intellectual concept; it has to be put into action).

owis.original: उपाये परियाये दीर्घ प्रेत्न । विवेकबळें नाना येत्न । करील तयाचें महिमान । तोचि जाणे ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकसंग्रह करण्याचे उपाय, त्याचे पर्याय, दीर्घ प्रयत्न, विवेकाच्या बळावर अनेक प्रकारचे यत्न करणें, जो जाणतो त्याचा मोठेपणा सामान्यांना कळणें कठीण असतें., त्याचा तोच जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When this remedy is performed through continuous effort then, these `many' efforts become unflinching vivek; then only will that paramatma come to know the magnificence of Its own Reality.

owis.original: दुर्जनीं वेवदरुन घेतला । बाश्कळ लोकीं घसरिला । विवेकापासून चेवला । विवेकी कैसा ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या भोवती दुर्जन आहेत, जो स्वैर लोकांच्या नादीं लागून घसरला आहे, जो विवेकापासून भ्रष्ट झाला आहे. अशा माणसाला विवेकी म्हणता येणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: How can one be a viveki, if vivek is lost when harassed by that which is far from the atma (ie. if you listen to your confused or wandering mind) and set upon and belittled by the foolish and reckless?

owis.original: न्याये परियाये उपाये । मूर्खास हें कळे काये । मूर्खाकरितां चिवडा होये । मज्यालसीचा ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: न्याय म्हणजे काय, उपाय व पर्याय म्हणजे काय, या गोष्टी मूर्खास कळत नाहेंत. मूर्ख माणसामुळें सभेचा विचका होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: *Equanimity is the nature of this remedy. How can a fool know that thoughtless Self? Understand that it is on account of your own foolishness, that your ability and power has been washed away. *(To see all with the eyes of knowledge)

owis.original: मग ते शाहाणे नीट करिती । स्वयें साहोन साहविती । स्वयें करुन करविती । लोकांकरवीं ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सभेमधें गोंधळ झाल्यावर शाहाणे तो नीट करतात. स्वतः सोसून ते इतरांना सहन करायला शिकवतात.. त्याचप्रमाणें तें स्वतः करतात व इतरांकडून करवून घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But if such foolishness is made ready and right through wisdom, then naturally there will be patience and forbearance and the making of further patience and forbearance. And then, when that One acts naturally, this whole world will be acting naturally (for there is only yourself in the world; maharaj- when you are happy, the whole world is happy).

owis.original: पृथ्वीमधें उदंड जन । जनामधें असती सज्जन । जयांकरितां समाधान । प्राणीमात्रासी ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत पुष्कळ माणसें आहेत. त्यापैकी कांहीं सज्जन असतात. त्या सज्जनांकडून लोकांना समाधान मिळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this earth (ie. gross objectification) there is that paramatma and there is a man. And within this man there is that Saint. If this man in only the prana, understands this mula maya, then he can gain complete contentment (ie. thoughtlessness).

owis.original: तो मनोगतांचीं आंगें जाणे । मान प्रसंग समये जाणे । संतप्तालागीं निवऊं जाणे । नाना प्रकारें ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सज्जन म्हणजे संत. संताला लोकांचें अंतःकरण बरोबर कळतें. मान, प्रसंग, काळवेळ त्याला बरोबर समजतात. भडकलेल्या लोकांना शांत कसें करायचे याचे अनेक प्रकार त्यांना माहीत असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma knows the original wish. That atma knows and has respect for this original connection. And when that atma knows then, there is the assuaging of the hot tempered and passionate caused by the `many' thoughts.

owis.original: ऐसा तो जाणता लोक । समर्थ तयाचा विवेक । त्याचें करणें कांहीं येक । जनास कळेना ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असा जो ज्ञानी पुरुष असतो त्याचा विवेक फारच सामर्थ्यसमपन्न असतो. त्याचेम कार्य करणें लोकांना आकलन होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma knows this world of the `all' then, the vivek of the Master is required (ie. I do not exist). But even this action of knowledge is not understood by the people.

owis.original: बहुत जनास चालवी । नाना मंडळें हालवी । ऐसी हे समर्थपदवी । विवेकें होते ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो अनेक लोकांना मार्गदर्शन करतो. अनेक लोकसंग्रह कार्यरत करतो. अशा विवेकपूर्ण वागण्यानें समर्थ ही पदवी प्राप्त होते.
owis.englishMeaning: It is this `all' that makes the people function and it is this `all' that makes the `many' gathering places move. And this thoughtless understanding of the Master can only appear when there is such vivek.

owis.original: विवेक एकांतीं करावा । जगदीश धारणेनें धरावा । लोक आपला आणी परावा । म्हणोंचि नये ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकांतामधें विवेक करावा.भगवंताला मनांत धारणेच्या जोरावर धरुन ठेवावा. हा आपला आणि हा परका असा लोकांमधें भेद करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: In this `aloneness' there should be such vivek and in this `aloneness' that Lord of the world should be firmly held with fortitude and steadfastness. Then you will not say that there are these two worlds (when One is there, where is this world of `I am' or this world of `many' names and forms?).

owis.original: येकांतीं विवेक ठाईं पडे । येकांतीं येत्न सांपडे । येकांतीं तर्क वावडे । ब्रह्मांडगोळीं ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकांतांत विवेक बरोबर चालतो. एकांतांत यत्न कोणता करावा तें समजतें. एकांतांमधें आपली बुद्धी संपूर्ण ब्रह्मांड फिरुन येते.
owis.englishMeaning: In this `aloneness', vivek will be discovered. In this `aloneness', effort will be found. In this `aloneness', the logic of this gross world within the brahmanda is left aside.

owis.original: येकांतीं समरण करावें । चुकलें निधान पडे ठावें । अंतरात्म्यासरिसें फिरावें । कांहीं तरी ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकांतांत बसून स्मरण करावें. म्हणजे आपल्या हातून झालेल्या चुका आपल्या ध्यानांत येतात. एकांतामधे आपण अमतरात्म्यायेवढें होऊन फिरावें. आपण त्याच्यासारखें व्यापक व्हावें आणि जगदांतरी फिरावें.
owis.englishMeaning: In `aloneness' there should be remembrance (ie. forgetting is remembering) and this forgotten hidden treasure will be discovered. Then this `thing' can care-freely wander along with that antar-atma (ie. then you use knowledge to stay in the world).

owis.original: जयास येकांत मानला । अवघ्या आधीं कळे त्याला । त्यावेगळें वडिलपणाला । ठावचि नाहीं ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसाला एकांत आवडला त्याला सर्वांच्या अगोदर ज्ञान होतें. ज्याला मोठेपणा मिळवायचा असेल त्याला एकांतसेवनाखेरीज मार्ग नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya values this `aloneness' then, that atma knows the `many' things from their root and there is none more senior to this atma who can know (ie. beyond this there is no knowing and no other). .
